tṛṇaparṇapalāśortha piṣṭikāṅganarabhasma ca | aṅgulīñca na śasye tat (----------------) kṣayaḥ | mantrāśca munayo devāḥ pitarastatparāṅmukhāḥ | bhaviṣyantu dine bhānau kuryāścedvi (---) ti t parvaṣaṣṭhīnāṃ navamyekādaśī tathā | kāṣṭhānāṃ dantasaṃyoge dahatyāsaptamaṃgu(ku)lam |
aṣṭa (-------------------) pañcadaśyāṃ trijanmi (nmani) |

vāruṇaṃ vāriṇā snānam āgneyaṃ bhasmanā bhavet | vṛṣṭyā sātapayā divyaṃ vāyavyaṃ rajasā (--------------) ||
(---------)navamityuktaṃ pañcasnānāḥ prakīrttitāḥ |

nadyāṃ vāpyāṃ taṭāke vā kūpe cāpi caturvidha | (----------------) (kurvan) āvyan nadyādiṣu ca satsvapi ||

(snānavidhiḥ)
(5ā) kūpāddaśaguṇaṃ vāpī vāpyā daśaguṇaṃ nadī | tasmāt daśaguṇaṃ (-) nadīṃ caiva samudragām ||
tataśśataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ snānaṃ prāṅmukha ucyate | pravāhābhimukho bhūtvā nadyāṃ snānaṃ samācaret ||
tatrāpi dakṣiṇaṃ tīramā (---) phalamāvahet | toyaṃ śuddhamaśuddhaṃ vā śivālaya samīpagam ||
śivagaṅgeti taṃ vidyāt śivadhāmāmbusecanāt |
śaivapurāṇe (-)
devālayasthitaṃ tīrthaṃ dūṣayenna kadācana | nātyantamaśucistatra snānaṃ kuryāttu karhi ca (cit) ||
kāmike (-)
athavā svagṛhe taptavāriṇā śītalena vā |
navāṣṭapañcabhiḥ kumbhaiḥ śivamantraṃ (-ntra) prakalpitaiḥ | tatassvāliptabhūpṛṣṭhe pīṭhasta (-sthaḥ) snānamācaret ||
anyatra (-)
nābheradhaḥ praviśyāmbu kaṭiṃ prakṣālya mṛjjalaiḥ | śuddha rdṛkapaṭenāṅgaṃ mārjanaṃ kāpilā smṛtam ||
strīvālānāṃ mahīśānāṃ (ajī-) rogiṇāṃ ca pravāsinām | uṣṇodakena snānaṃ vā kaṇṭhasnānamathāpi vā ||
pañcapiṇḍānanuddhṛtya na snāyāt (--) vāriṇā (-ṣu) | mṛt ri(--------) śataguṇaṃ bhavet ||
tāmbraśśataguṇaṃ (tāmrāt) raupyaṃ rajatāt haimakaṃ śatam | kuṇḍodaṃ ca nipātaṃ ca sāpi snānasamaṃ bhavet ||
suprabhede (-)
apraśastaṃ niśi snānaṃ praśastaṃ grahaṇeṣu ca | vṛttasya (pra-) rudhiraṃ nityaṃ sravanti niśi nimnagāḥ ||
tasmā(t) snānaṃ ca pānaṃ ca na kurvīta kadācana | agniṃ vāpi suvarṇaṃ vā darśayet jalasannidhau ||
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ vāpi kārayeddeśikottamaḥ | jalaśuddhirbhavet devaṃ niśi snānaṃ na (ca) gadyate ||
tasmāddivaiva gṛhṇīyāt devārthaṃ cātmanaśchivaiḥ |
jñānaratnāvalyām (-)
samācamya kṛtanyāso darbhahastaḥ prasannadhīḥ | prāṇāyamatrayaṃ kṛtvā saṃhitāṃ praṇavaṃ vadat ||
adyāmuke ravau māse tithivāre saridvare | snānaṃ deva kariṣyāmi tvatpūjārthaṃ prasīda me ||
hūṃphaṭkāreṇa śuddhaṃ ca mṛdaṃ saṅgṛhya sādhakaḥ |
kālottare (-)
parvatāstvā nadīkūlāt puṇyakṣetre śucisthale | brahmavṛkṣāt ku(kra) (-----) dhasthā dastrakhātāṃ surakṣitām ||
tālamānāpratho mṛsnāmādāya (mṛtsnā-) hṛdayena tu | sañcayet bhūtale śuddhe yāvanmāsacatuṣṭayam ||
varṣākālena gṛhṇīyāt (*?) (śrā)ddhe rikṣe viśeṣataḥ | sakṛjjaptena cāstreṇa mṛdaṃ māhya cakṣaṇaḥ | malasnānaṃ purākṛtvā vidhisnānaṃ samācaret |
taduktam(-)
rajanīkaraṇapiṣṭaistu aṅgapratyaṅgakarṣiṇam |
malasnānamiti proktaṃ mantrasnānaṃ tataśśṛṇu | nāsikā śrotra netrorthamudakena viśuddhayati ||
vaktraṃ ca dantakāṣṭhena keśyaṃ cāmalakādibhiḥ | adbhiśca śuddhamṛdbhiśca śeṣaṃ prakṣālayet tanum ||
suprabhede (-)
matsyamaṇḍūkasarpādyairanyaiśca jalajātibhiḥ | sevitaṃ tu jalaṃ nityaṃ tasmādyuktaṃ (tasmāduktaṃ) viśeṣataḥ ||
taddoṣaśamanārthāya śivatīrthaṃ prakalpayet | (***?) (hastamātra) pramāṇena paritaścaturaśrakam ||
huṃphaṭkāreṇa cāstreṇa mṛdaṃ grāhya vicakṣaṇaḥ | hṛdyena sthāpayenmantrī vāmadevena secayet ||
a (-----)puruṣeṇa tribhāgikam | pūrvaṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ caiva uttaraṃ ca tridhā bhavet ||
īśānena tu mantreṇa ekaika ma ga trayet a (------) brahma śivāṅgāni nyaset pūrvāditaḥ kramāt ||
astrajaptaṃ tu yadbhāgaṃ daśa dikṣu vinikṣipet | śivajaptaṃ tu yadbhāgaṃ tīrthamadhye vi (*?) kṣipet (vini-) ||
phaṭkāreṇa tu mantreṇa nārācāstraprayogataḥ | jale sūkṣmāśca ye doṣāsteṣāmuccāṭa (*?) (naṃ) bhavet ||
brahmajaptena cāṃśena ātmanoṅgāni kuṇḍayet | upaspṛśya tatassnāyāt śivatīrthasya madhyame ||
cintyaviśve (-)
candrārkarūpahastābhyāṃ secayet kumbhamudrayā | vauṣaḍantena mūlena brahmabhiśca muhurmuhuḥ ||
abhiṣiñcet kramā kṣityamamṛtāmbu vibhāvayan | jalakrīḍāvasāne tu vaktramudrābhiṣecayet ||
siddhānte (-)
aṅguṣṭhābhyāmubhau karṇau tarjanībhyāṃ ca cakṣuṣī | (7ā) madhyamāsyaṃ nibadhnīyāt nāsikāyugalaṃ dṛḍham ||
pañcabrahma śivāṅgaiśca triḥ paṭhedadhamarṣaṇam |
suprabhede (-)
a (*?) rjale (agar-) pidhāyākṣaṃ sarvāṅgainaiva darśayet | darśaye ca tataścārthamukhamāgneya vā punaḥ ||
mukhamagniśca yatjaptvamekaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet | arthāṅgenaiva sāhasraṃ nimagnaṃ koṭirucyate ||
smṛtau (-)
pibanti śiraso deva pibanti pitaro mukhāt | madhyatassarvagandharvamadhastāt sarvajantavaḥ ||
tasmāt snātonavāmṛjya snānaśāddhyāna pāṇina | tisraḥ koṭyārdhakoṭiśca yāvantyaṅgaruhāṇi vaiḥ ||
sravanti sarvatīrthāni tebhyo na parimārjayet | dhyānayukto viniṣkramya krameṇācamanaṃ caret ||
vikāreṇa tu mantreṇa śivatīrthaṃ tu saṅgrahet | aṅgalagnajalaṃ śuṣkapaṭena parimārjayet ||
ārdraścet saptadhā dhūnyanna (---) ni parimārjayet | śuddhavastraṃ samācchādya ārdravastraṃ visarjayet ||
jñānaratnāvalyām (-)
(7B) naikavastraḥ (-vastrī) kriyāṃ kuryāt nnagnakaupenakevalaḥ (tna-) | snāne devārcane yāge bhojane ca vipaścitaḥ ||
smṛtau (-)
nagno malinavastrasya nagna śa taḥ | nagnastu dagdhavastraṃ (ḥ) syāt nagnassūtapaṭassmṛtaḥ ||
aṃśumati (-)
ārdravastreṇa saṃyuktaḥ karma kuryādatandritaḥ | vṛthā bhavati tat karma punassnānena śuddhyati ||
vīratantre (-)
dhvardite dyutite bsūyye śmaśrukarmaṇi maithune | dussvapne durjanasparśe snānaṃ ṣaṭsu vidhīyate ||
śivadharmottare (-)
vastraśaucaṃ pravakṣyāmi tacchuddhau śuddhyate yataḥ | vastraśauca vihīnātmā śucirapyaśucirbhavet ||
devakāryopayogena (-nā) pratyahaṃ śaucamiṣyate | vāsasāmitareṣāṃ ca kāryaṃ śaucaṃ malodgame ||
smṛtau (-)
vastraṃ caturguṇīkṛtya pīḍayitvā jalādbahiḥ | vāmaprakoṣṭhe nikṣipya dvirācamya viśuddhyati ||
yadā yadā ca saṃsnātaḥ tadā sandhyāmupāsayet | snānakāle yatassarve pyupa tiṣṭhanti nityaśaḥ ||
tasmāt devānmunīn siddhān pitarastarpaye (---) |
(8ā) anyadhā te payantyūrdhvennirāśāstatparāṅmukhāḥ | (-------------------) ścet payacchanti tṛptāssarve bhīpsitāḥ ||
a (--------) cāstreṇa tridhā saṃprokṣayet budhaḥ | tarpaṇaṃ cāstramantreṇa tridhā taṃvyajapeddaśa ||
evaṃ ca tarpayessandhya yadvā (---------) hṛda ret | jalasnānamidaṃ proktaṃ bhasmasnānaṃ tata śśṛṇu ||
surāsurairmathyamānāt kṣīrodādārṇavokta | pañcagāvāssamutpannāssarvalokasya mātaraḥ ||
nandā bhadrā ca surabhiḥ suśīlā sumanā tathā | gāvaśśivapu pañcakṣitaṃ prāptaśśivecchayā ||
kapilaṃ kṛṣṇaśvetaṃ ca dhūmraṃ raktaṃ tathaiva ca | sarvalokopakāra(----) (-rāya) devānāṃ tarpaṇāya ca ||
gomātarassthitā bhūmau snānārthaṃ ca śivasya tu | gomayaṃ rocanā mūtraṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ (----) ||
ṣaḍaṅgāni pavitrāṇi sarvasiddhikarāṇi ca | gobhiryajña pravartante gopu devāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ | gobhirvedāssamutpannāssaṣaḍaṅgapadakramāt (ḥ) | (8B) śṛṅgamūle gavāṃ nityaṃ brahmaviṣṇū pratiṣṭhitau ||
śṛṅgāgre sarvatīrthāni sthāvarāṇi ca(rā?)ṇi ca | (---) dhye tvahaṃ vatsassarvabhūtaissamāvṛtaḥ ||
lalāṭe saṃsthito vatsa bhrātā tatra viśeṣataḥ | kambalāśvatarau nāgau nāsāpu(ṭa) samāśritau ||
karṇayoraśvinīdevau cakṣuṣīśśaśibhāskarau (cakṣuṣaśaśi-) | danteṣu maruto devāḥ jihvāya (-yāṃ) varuṇassthitaḥ ||
sarasvatī ska kāre yamayakṣau ca gaṇḍayoḥ | oṣṭhadvaye sthite sandhye grīvecendrassamāśritaḥ ||
khuramadhye tu gandharvā (--) khurāgreṣu ca pannagāḥ | khurāṇāṃ paścimāgreṣu apsarāṇāṃ gaṇāssthitāḥ ||
rudrāstu daśanāḍī sthā yā (------------------) sandhiṣu | śroṇītaṭasthaḥ (-thā) pitara urassthā syādumā bhavet ||
śrīrapāne gavāṃ nityaṃ komalāgramalāśritaḥ | ādi (----------------------) gomūtre jāhnavīsvayam ||
ṛṣayaśca tathā sarve romāgreṣu ca saṃsthitāḥ | udare pṛthivī (*?) (-kṣe) saśailavanakānanaḥ ||
(9ā) catvārassāgarāḥ pūrṇāṃgavāṃ hyeva payodharāḥ | gomayādutthitaśrīmān bilvavṛkṣaḥ śivapriyaḥ ||
tatrāste padmahastā śrīśśrīvṛkṣastena cocyate | bījānyutpalapadmānāṃ punarjātāni gomayāt ||
kathitāssarvā nityaṃ goṣu pratiṣṭhitāḥ | itthaṃ gāvatsamālokya (yā-) bhasmārthaṃ gomayaṃ grahet ||
svāyaṃbhuve (-)
prātarutthāya deveśi maunaṃ vratasamanvitam | gavāṃ goṣṭhe ca gatvā tu namaskṛtvā tu gokulam ||
gorocanaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ mannaṃ cāpi pradāpayet | tāmbūlaṃ dāpayitvā tu gosāvitrīṃ śataṃ japet ||
tīkṣṇaśṛṅgāya vidmahe devapādāya dhīmahi tanno gāyaḥ pracodayāt ||
brāhmaṇasya tathā śveto raktā vai kṣatriyasya tu | pītavarṇaṃ tu vaiśyasya kṛṣṇaṃ śūdrasya cocyate ||
paurṇamāsyā mamāvāsyāmaṣṭamyāṃ grahaṇadvayoḥ | kramādvai gomayaṃ grāhyamanyathā grāhayenna tu ||
bandhyā vṛddhā vyādhitā ca durlakṣaṇayutā tathā | (9B) karṇakena vihīne ca bālakākhyaṃ vinākṛta (-kuta) ||
amedhyāhāra ya nya dhyā gā (---) ñcaivānukalpaṃ ca upakalpamakalpakam ||
teṣāṃ lakṣaṇakaṃ caiva kramācchṛṇuta suvrata | salakṣaṇāca kapilā raktā śuklā sitetarā ||
tāsāṃ ca gomayaṃ padmapatrairambhodbhavaistathā | palāśapatrakovāpi hastābhyāṃ vyomni dhārayet ||
koṣṭhe vā gomayaṃ grāhya sabdomantreṇa dhārayet | piṇḍāni vāmamantreṇa aghoreṇa tu śoṣayet ||
dehe tatpuruṣeṇaiva īśāne tu saṅgrahe | anukalpaṃ tataścaiva śṛṇutvaṃ nandikeśvara ||
vane śuṣkaṃ sakudgrāhya cūrṇitaṃ tu tathā dahet | vastreṇāntaritaṃ bhasmaṃ gomūtrābaddhapiṇḍakam ||
dagdhaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā bhavet bhasmopakalpanam | pūrvoktavidhimutsṛjya kevalaṃ bhasmasādhanam ||
anyenāpāditaṃ bhasmamakalpamiti kalpakam | puruṣeṇa viśeṣeṇa navabhāṇḍeṣu vinyaset ||
(10ā) pañca brahma śivāṅgaiśca vyomavyāpiṃ sakṛjjapet |
cintyaviśve (-)
karpūrośīrahī bera ketakīścambakaistathā | damaneśānamantreṇa kṣipettasmin viśeṣataḥ ||
ketakīmallikānāṅgaṃ campakaṃ pāṭalaṃ tathā | padmā palāśaṃ tulasī mapāmārgaṃ kuśāgrakam ||
jātīṃ ca tatra nikṣipya sadbhāṇḍeṣu parigrahet | alāpupātre matimān bhasmādhāre vinikṣipet ||
bhasmālayaṃ tu śaktissyāt tadbhasmaṃ śiva eva tu | tantu brahmādhidevatvaṃ (-tyaṃ) kavacenaiva dhārayet ||
mataṅge (-)
jalasnā (naṃ) purā kṛtvā bhasmasnānaṃ tataḥ param | jalasnānatvaśaktaścet (jalasnāne-) bhasmasnānaṃ samācaret ||
somaśambhau (-)
īśānena śiroddhūlya mukhaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tu | aghoreṇaiva hṛdayaṃ nābhiṃ vāmena kīrttitaḥ ||
sarvāṅgaissadyamantreṇa samuddhūlya vicakṣaṇaḥ |
suprabhede (-)
athāto vidhisiddhena saṃhitāmantritena ca | nivṛtyādiviśuddhena bhasmanā snānamācaret ||
śirastatpādaparyantaṃ huṃphaḍantaśarāṇunā | (10B) malasnānamidaṃ jñeyaṃ śuddhasnāne mṛdaṃ vinā ||
cintyaviśve (-)
dvātriṃśatsandhideśeṣu (---) vā ṣoḍaśeṣu vā | aṣṭasandhiṣu vā mantrī pañcasthāne viyojayet ||
uttamāṅge lalāṭe ca karṇayornetrayostathā | nāsāgrayugale caiva maṃsadvayamataḥ param ||
korpare maṇibandhe ca hṛdaye pārśvayordvayoḥ | nābhau guhyadvaye caiva ūrosthidvandvajānuni ||
jaṅghadvaye (jaṅghā-) ca pādau ca dvātriṃśatsthānamuttamam | priyaṃ vai cāṣṭa (*?) (a) mūrtīnāṃ vidyeśānāṃ tathaiva ca ||
dikpālānāṃ vasūnāṃ ca mūrdhnādi parikalpayet |
kāraṇe (-)
śīrṣe ('pi) ca lalāṭe ca karṇe cāṃsadvayorapi | (karṇayoraṃsayorapi)
korpare maṇibandhe ca hṛdaye nābhipārśveke | pṛṣṭhe caivaṃ prati sthāne jaṅghe tatrādhidevatāḥ ||
tripuṇḍraṃ ṣoḍaśasthāne dhārayedvai śivāśramī | śīrṣe bhasma dhṛtaṃ gālopari kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ dahet tat gale
(11 ā) bhakṣyāghaṃ bhujayostu tatkṛtamaghaṃ vatse tu cittārcitam nābhau śiśnakṛtaṃ tathā gudakṛtaṃ
pṛṣṭhe padājānunoḥ
pārśveranyaparaṃ bhaṇādyamitiyat
skānde purāṇe smṛtaḥ ||
śivassadāśivaścaiva maheśā brahma pañcakam | vidyeśvarāśca vai vatsā ṣoḍaśābhyādhidevatāḥ ||
aṣṭasthānaṃ pravakṣyāmi tripuṇḍradevataṃ tathā | śirassthāne svayaṃ brahmā lalāṭe skanda meva ca ||
kaṇṭhe vināyakaḥ prīto bāhuvai viṣṇureva ca | hṛdaye īśvaraḥ prīto nābhau caiva vasuṃdharaḥ |
pṛṣṭhe ca pitaraḥ prīto stripuṇḍrāṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ | athavā mastakaṃ bāhuṃ hṛdayaṃ nābhimeva ca ||
pañca sthānaṃ lalāṭe ca pañcamūrtiśca devatā | ādhvaraṃ karma tatsarvaṃ tripuṇṭreṇaiva kārayet ||
akāro'nāmikā proktamukāro madhyamāṅguliḥ | makārastarjanīnāṃ ca stribhiretaistripuṇḍrakam ||
(11B) dviśatikālottare (-)
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca tripuṇḍrasyādhidevatāḥ | sṛṣṭiḥsthitiśca saṃhāraḥ tripuṇḍrasya svarūpataḥ ||
pṛṣṭhe ca pitaraḥ prīto (***?) (nābhau) caiva vasundharaḥ ||
suprabhede (-)
ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ tu vistāraṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ vidhīyate | caturaṅgula vistāraṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tripuṇḍrakam ||
triyaṅgulaṃ tu vaiśyānāṃ tripuṇḍrassarvakāmadaḥ | ekāṅgulaṃ tu śūdrāṇāṃ strīṇāṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ ||
tattadvaṃśavatī strīṇāṃ tattaddevaṃ vidhīyate ||

suprabhede (-)

uttamādṛṣṭanakṣatra madhyamā luptatārakā | ardhoditāruṇā kanyā prātassandhyāmupāsadā (-tā) ||

sugandhasvādusaṃyukto śvetaraktāthaviñchana | pāṃśusurabhyadhikā dhanyā bhūmissarvārthasādhinī ||
keśāsthikīṭakaṅkaikaira nāṅgattoṣā vivarjayatām | sarpavalamīkanirmuktāḥ bhasmāṅgāratuṣonvitām ||

sarvajñānottare (-)
(25ā) dairghyaṃ taddviguṇaṃ kṛtvā vistārecaikabhāgikam | dvāraṃ tṛtīyage bhāge sārtha(-rdha)hastapramāṇataḥ ||

aṃśumati (-)
sagustaṃ vyajanaṃ ramyaṃ prakīrṇaṃ kusumojjvalam | sa dhupāmodakandhāḍhyaṃ (-gandhāḍhyaṃ) carcitaṃ candanādibhiḥ |

aṃśumati (-)

sauraṃ pratimaberevā cakrenāpi samarcayet | sthaṇḍile padmamālikhya yathāpūrvoktamārgataḥ ||
kṛtvā karāṅgavinyāsaṃ tanmantre hṛdayādibhiḥ | ātmānaṃ ravirūpeṇa sañcintyārghyasya bhājanam ||

sūkṣme (-)
daṇḍidvā dakṣiṇe gauraṃ sthūla stundilakūrcavān | maṣībhājanalekhinyau dhārayan hastayordvayoḥ |
prāṇināṃ karmasākṣī ca tatkarmāṇi likhityasau | raktavarṇasuveṣāḍhyaḥ sūryahastasamanvitaḥ ||
piṅgalo vāmapārśve tu pratīhāraśca daṇḍavān | raktapadmāsanāsīnaṃ dantaṃ pāśāṅkuśau phalam ||
dadhānaṃ ca caturhastaiḥ gajavaktraṃ gaṇādhipam | jaṭāmakuṭaśobhāḍhyaṃ bhasma pāṇḍaranigraham ||
yogapaṭṭayutaṃ brahmasūtranābhisthalopari | (26ā) kṛtayogākhyamudrāṃ ca dhyoyecchāntaṃ guruṃ param ||
sitakāśmīraraktāli cārusihmākṛtismarit | āgneyādīśaparyantaṃ koṇeṣu ca yathākramam ||
vimalaṃ sāragārādhya pūjayet paramaṃ sukham | tanmadhye paṅkajaṃ raktamaṣṭadigdalaśobhitam ||
kesareṣu ca diptādi aṣṭaśakti prapūjayet | pūrvādīśānaparyantam īśāne sarvatomukham ||
dīptadīpaśikhākārā dhyātavyā navaśaktayaḥ | padmacāmarahastābhyāṃ raktā (ratnā) sarvāṅgabhūṣaṇaḥ ||
sūryasyābhimukhāssarvāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ | evaṃ dhyātvā tu sampūjya visphurāśca pradarśayet ||
sauraṃ kuṅkumasaṅkāśaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | dvinetraṃ ca (cā)ruvadanaṃ ratnamālyānulepanam ||
caturbhujasamopetaṃ varahastāmbujadvayam | abhayaṃ varadopetaṃ prabhāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam |
(26B) upavītasamāyuktamuṣāpratyuṣayā yutam | uṣādevī dakṣabhāge pratyuṣā vāmapārśvage ||
dvibhujā ca dvinetrā ca sarojavadanānvitam | sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam ||
padmahastā varārohamaruṇena samanvitam | suprasannaṃ sudīptāṅgaṃ dhyāyeddevaṃ (-yedevaṃ) ravervapuḥ ||

śakro'pi devarājendro liṅgaṃ maṇimayaṃ śubham | nitya mabhyarcate bhaktyā tena śakratvamāptavān ||

(30B) viśvedevā mahātmāno raupyaliṅgaṃ manoharam | yajate vidhivat tena viśvadevatvamāpnuyāt |

vasuvaḥ kāṃsyakaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayanti vidhānataḥ | prāptāstena mahātmāno vasutvaṃ sumanodayam ||
aśvinau pārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayantau vidhānataḥ | tena tāvaśvinau devau divyadehaṃ gatāvubhau ||
sphaṭikaṃ nirmalaṃ liṅgaṃ varuṇo'rcayate sadā | tenāsau varuṇatvaṃ hi prāptamuddhibalānvitam ||
liṅgamannamayaṃ puṇyaṃ muniryajati bhāvitaḥ | agnitvaṃ prāptavāṃstena tejorūpasamanvitam ||

(31ā) muktāphalamayaṃ liṅgaṃ somaḥ pūjayate sadā | tena somo'pi saṃprāpta somatvaṃ satatojjvalam ||
pravālakamayaṃ liṅgaṃ jayante (yajante) pannagottamāḥ | tena nāgāssubhogāḍhyāḥ prayānti paramaṃ padam ||
kṛṣnāya samayaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayatyāsurottamaḥ | rākṣasāśca mahātmānastena tetmata vikramāḥ ||
trapusīsamayaṃ liṅgaṃ piśācāḥ pūjayanti te | tena ṛddhibalopetāḥ prāpnuvanti paraṃpadam ||
trailohikamayaṃ liṅgaṃ yajante guhyakottamaḥ | tena bhogabalopetā prayānti paramaṃ padam ||
bahulohamayaṃ liṅgaṃ yajante mātarassadā | mātṛtvaṃ prāpya tāssarvāḥ prayānti paramaṃ padam ||
evaṃ devāssagandharvāssayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ | pūjayanti sadā kāla mīśānaṃ suranāyakam ||

indranīlaṃ tu mokṣārthaṃ ratnajānāṃ phalaṃ bhavet | aṅgulyādivitastyāntaṃ kuryāt liṅgaṃ tu ratnajam ||
āyāmasadṛśaṃ nāhaṃ śirovartanasaṃyutam | svapramāṇena karttavyaṃ ratnaliṅgasya pīṭhikā ||
piṇḍikāsvasvayonismāt tadabhāve hiraṇyakam | (34B) rajataṃ tāmrakaṃ caiva adhamaṃ ceti kīrtitam ||
caturaśrāthavṛttaṃ vā calaliṅgasya pīṭhikā | āyāmadviguṇārthaṃ vā dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ tu vā ||
vistāraṃ tat samaṃ jñeyaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvoktavat kuru | liṅgayāmaṃ tribhāgaikaṃ pīṭhamadhye niveśayet ||
sarvavittakaraṃ liṅgaṃ tribhāgaṃ sūtravarjitam | ratnaliṅgaṃ samākhyātaṃ lohajaṃ liṅgamucyate ||
suvarṇena kṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ bhavet | tāmbra(mra)jaṃ putradaṃ proktaṃ rajataṃ śrīkaraṃ bhavet ||
sukhadaṃ kāṃsyamityuktaṃ paittalaṃ roganāśanam | ayasyaṃ śatrunāśaṃ tu trilohaṃ māraṇaṃ bhavet ||
tathā ca trapusīsaṃ tu kalpayet kalpavittamaḥ | ratnajasyoktamārgeṇa kalpayet kalpavittamaḥ ||

nirmadā |
nirmadāsambhavaṃ rogaṃ bāṇaliṅgamudīritam | svayambhūtaṃ sadā pūjyaṃ sarvaliṅgottamottamam ||
tredhaivasphaṭikaśśucinduravikāntākhyastandāndikramādvarṇānāṃ sitaraktavidyullasitatrāsādidoṣānvitāḥ |
anyaścandrakarātraṃ vatnatitaro dīpyeta sūryātape pīṭhaṃ ca svaprabhavaṃ navasvadṛṇiṣvevahi hemnā'pivā | ambubindunibhaṃ svacchaṃ samacandraprabhānvitam ||
aśeṣadoṣanirmuktaṃ sphaṭikaṃ sarvakāmadam | niṣprabhaṃ nirmukhaṃ rūkṣaṃ bahuvarṇaṃ ca jharjharam ||
tuṣārakaṇa santrāsarekhācibṛsaṃyugam | sagarbhakīlakopetaṃ śarkarāvraṇasaṃyutam ||
anyajātisamākrāntaṃ sadoṣaṃ sphaṭikaṃ tyajet | (35B) bāṇaśśivaśśaktiramuṣyabāṇai talliṅgamāhuḥ khalu bāṇaliṅgam | śivārpitaṃ tasya samarcanena balīnduputrojani bāṇanāma ||
syāt koṭi tisṛśṛgirau (-tirau) liṅgaśaile kāligarte (kālī-) nirmadā bāṇaliṅgam | ekaṃ koṭiścāmareśe mahendre kanyātīrthāraṇya nepālakeṣu ||
paryāyātulayā dhṛtaṃ yadi mahā sāmyānayatve va yat (dhat) kṣiptaṃ vāri tadevalabhyamapiyat tadbāṇaliṅgaṃ viduḥ tuṅgaṃ tasya śiraḥ padaṃ kuśamato (kṛśa-) yadvā spṛśedarcitā | kanyā pañcavayastadevahimukhaṃ naivāsya lakṣmoddhṛti ||
utpattiṃ bāṇaliṅgānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca tataśśṛṇu | narmadā daivikārthāśca gaṅgāyamunayostathā ||
santi puṇyanadīnāṃ ca bāṇaliṅgāni ṣaṇmukha | bāṇassadāśivo jñeyo bāṇo bāṇāndhakāsuraḥ ||
bāṇaṃ jalamiti jñeyaṃ tasmāt bāṇamihocyate |

karkaśe bāṇaliṅge tu putradārakṣayo bhavet | śirasstharitabāṇe tu vyādhirmaraṇameva ca ||

apitāni ṣaḍaśrāṇi vaktrāṅgāni viśeṣataḥ | (36B) indraliṅgāni tānyāhuḥ sāmbrā(-mrā)jyārthapradāni tu ||
asitaṃ himakīlālaṃ muṣṇaṃ sparśāt karotyakam | āgneyaṃ śaktisaṅkāśamathanā śaktilāñchitam |
idaṃ liṅga raṃ sthāpya tejaso'dhipatirbhavet | daṇḍākāramayaṃ yāmyamathavā rasanākṛtiḥ ||
yathā saṅgaṃ muhūrtena nirṇitaṃ jāyate tadā (-thā?) | vāruṇaṃ vartulākāraṃ pīṭhāṅgaṃ vātivarcasam ||
vṛddhisusthādusvajatvamāpo yantyapsu madhyage | kṛṣṇaṃ dhūmraṃ tu vāyavyaṃ sa dhūmadhvajabhūṣaṇam ||
mastake sthāpitā tasya sacela nihitaṃ tu vā | nirvāte (-rghāte) vicalasmātra śatroruccāṭane matam |
gadākāraṃ madhyaguru kauberaṃ sasya madhyagam | dinaṃ vāpyathavā rātriṃ sasyānāṃ vṛddhivardhanam ||
tryaśraṃ śūlāṅgitaṃ raudraṃ himakundenduvarcasam | cāturvarṇyamayaṃ vā'pi vṛṣabhaṃ jāyate grataḥ ||
vaiṣṇavaṃ śaṅkhacakrāṅgaṃ gadā'bjādi vibhūṣitam | (37ā) śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhākrāntaṃ kolaṃ sihānākṛtim ||
vainateyasamākaṃ yat śrībhūdevīsamāṅgitam | vaiṣṇavaṃ nāma tat proktaṃ sarvaiśvarya phalapradam ||
padmapatrasya varṇantu padmāṅkaṃ vā kamaṇḍalum (-lam) | daṇḍākṣasūtravarṇaṃ vā brahmaṇe jñaptidaṃ mada(na)m |
arcyā syāt kapilaṃ liṅgaṃ munīnāṃ mokṣakāṃkṣiṇām | laghu vā kapilaṃ (liṃ)gaṃ grahī naivārcayet kvacit ||
tīkṣṇāṅgaṃ vakraśīrṣaṃ ca tryaśraṃ liṅgaṃ ca varjayet | atisthūlamatikṛśaṃ saptaśubhraghanānvitam ||
grahī vivarjayet tādṛk taṃ mumukṣoryuto hitam | pūjitasya grahasthena varṇena bhramaropamam ||
bāṇaliṅgaṃ yadā haste tadā'sau ṇagrakaṃ bhavet |
jñānaratnāvalyām (-)
tripañca saptavāraṃ vā tulāsāmyaṃ na jāyate | tādā bāṇaṃ samākhyātaṃ śeṣaṃ pāṣāṇasambhavam ||
nadyāṃ vā prakṣipet bhūyo yadā tadupalabhyate | tadā bāṇaṃ samākhyātamanyathā kleśadāyakam ||

aṃśumati (-)
(37B) sūtakāśauce ātmārthamejanaṃ smṛtam | pūjākopenakartavyaṃ sūtake mṛtake'pi vā ||
śivamantreṇa karttavyaṃ snānamātreṇa śuddhyati | āśaucaṃ na bhavettatra padmapatramivāmbhasā ||
pūjānte praviśecchedamāśaucaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | evaṃ liṅgārcanaṃ kuryāt kāmyānuṣṭhānahīnakaḥ ||
athavā sūtakaprete na svayaṃ liṅgapūjanam | mānasaṃ ca yajeddhīmān sarvaṃ mānasakalpanam ||
talliṅgaṃ pūjayitvā tu gurūṇāṃ vā svajātināṃ | anye tu norcanaṃ kuryāt dante puṣpāñjalitrayam ||
kathaṃ puṣpavatī nārī arcanaṃ gurudevatā | antaryāgaṃ prakartavyaṃ tayā pūrvadinatrayam ||
caturthe divase snātvā gavyaṃ prāśya yajettu sā | corairliṅgaṃ gṛhītaṃ cet manasā tu yajettataḥ ||
catvāriṃśaddināntaṃ ca upavāsaṃ tu kārayet | nālikerodakenaiva kṣīreṇaiva phalādinā ||
(38ā) ātmānaṃ rakṣayeddhīmān śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena taṃ liṅgaṃ gṛ(grā)hyameva ca ||
labdhaṃ cet tatsamādāya prītiyukto viśeṣataḥ | liṅgaśuddhiṃ kramāt kṛtvā pūjayet pūrvavat budhaḥ |
talliṅgamātrālabdhaṃ cet navaliṅgaṃ tu saṅgrahet | svaguro liṅgamādāya pūjayet pūrvamārgataḥ ||
dṛṣṭaṃ cet pūrvaliṅgaṃ tu dvayaṃ sampūjayet tataḥ |
kālottare (-)
mṛṇmayaṃ dvividhaṃ kāryamapakvāpakvameva ca | apakvāt pakvaje puṇye jñeyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ tataḥ ||
pakvā dārumayaṃ puṇyam jñeyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ tataḥ | dārurā(-jā) chailajaṃ puṇyaṃ jñeyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ smṛtam ||
tasmāt śataguṇaṃ lohe lohāt ratnamanantakam | (38B) ratnāt maṇimaye liṅge phalaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet ||
saṃsmṛtaṃ bāṇaliṅgantu ratnāt koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet | rasaliṅgaṃ tato bāṇāt phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ smṛtam ||

nadīmudbhūmilebhaṃ gomayaṃ rājanāśanam | navanītaṃ manohlādaṃ rudrākṣaṃ jñānavardhanam ||

niśvāsakārikāyām (-)
ekakāle dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ vārdharātrikam | pūjayecca tataśśambhuṃ nityameva grahī tataḥ ||
rudrākṣaṃ ca tripuṇṭraṃ ca japahomārcanādiṣu | yajanaṃ niṣphalaṃ sarvaṃ dīkṣāhīnasya pārvati ||
kāmike (-)

śivadharme (-)

merumandaramātrāpi rāśī(-śiḥ) pāpasya karmaṇaḥ | (39B) īśvaraṃ vaidyamāsādya naśyante duṣṭarogavat ||

kālottare (-)
arudrākṣadharo mantrī yaḥ karoti śivārcanam | tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ proktaṃ bhasmanyena hutaṃ haviḥ ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena rudrākṣaṃ dhārayet budhaḥ |

tripuraṃ nāma daityastu purā'sīt sarvadurjayaḥ | hatāstena surāssarve brahmaviṣṇvagnidevatāḥ ||
taissarvaiḥ kathiti tasmin na dāhaṃ tripura prati | ācintaya mahāśāstraṃ sarvaśāstremanoharam ||
sarvadevamayaṃ divyaṃ jvalantaṃ ghorarūpiṇam | tripurasya vadhārthāya devānāṃ trāṇakāraṇam ||
sarvavighnavināśāya aghorāstraṃ vicintayan | divyavarṣasahasrāṇi cakṣurunmīlitaṃ mayā ||

lambodaraṃ śyāmatanuṃ gaṇeśaṃ kuṭhāramakṣasrajamūrdhvagābhyām | salaḍḍukaṃ dantamadhaḥ karābhyāṃ vāme karābhyāṃ ca dadhānamīḍe ||
śuklaṃ śuklāmbarāmakṣamālāpustakadhāriṇīm | savyavāmakarābhyāṃ ca suprasannāṃ sarasvatīm ||

raktaṃ triṇetraṃ jaṭilaṃ savyavāmakaradvaye | akṣamālāṃ triśūlāṃ ca dadhānaṃ nandikeśvaram ||
makarāsanagāṃ gaṅgāṃ savyavāmakaradvayoḥ | nīlotpalaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ dadhatīṃ śuklarūpiṇīm ||

(43ā) siddhāntaśekhare (-)
ṣaḍadhvāsthāni bāhyāni tāni śuddhāni dīkṣayā | dehasthitāni bhūtāni śoddhyāni syāddinedine ||
caraṇāṅguṣṭhayoryugmāt sañcintya suṣirāntanau | suṣirāntabahiśśaktiṃ vyāpinīṃ cintayet tataḥ ||
hūṃkāre randhramadhyasthe prajvalana pāvakapra (---) | (?)vidhāya prāṇasaṃrodhaṃ cittamantraṃ niveśayet ||
recakānte phaṭāntena hṛtkaṇṭhe kucatāluṣu | bhrūmadhye brahmarandhre ca bhitvā granthi nivartya ca ||
huṃkāraṃ tārakākāraṃ jīvaṃ hṛdayasaṃpuṭam | pūrakāhṛdacaitanyaṃ hūṃ śivopari vinyaset ||
saṃśuddhaṃ bindu bhūtaṃ ca dhyātvā kṛtvā ca kumbhakam | recakena śive vidvānekoddhātena yojayet ||
saṃhāramudrayā dāya mūrtiṃmantreṇa vigrahāt | bhogyakarmopabhogyārthaṃ calāśāntapade yathā ||
bījapravṛtyā śive līnapratilomaṃ svahetuṣu | tattvāni (tantvāni) bījaparyantaṃ layaṃ nītvā viśodhayet ||
gandhe bhūssalilaṃ rasehutavahorūpemarusparśane (42B) śabde'syāt khamahaṃ kṛtau punarimāḥ tanmātrikāstāmase | karmākṣāṇi ca rājase sahamanobuddhīndriyaissātvike buddhau taśca guṇeṣu sā guṇagaṇovyakte layaṃ gacchati (-tī) |
tadrāgavidye ca kalāṃ prayānti puṃstvaṃ ca kāloniyatiḥ kalā ca | māyaṃ svavidyeśamasau sadeśaṃ saśaktimeṣā śivameṣu bindavaḥ ||
evaṃ vidhāya saṃśuddhiṃ pañcabhūtāni śodhayet | pathivyādau payo vahni dvau dvau śoddhyau parasparau ||
ākāśaṃ ca virodhena yathā śoddhyaṃ taducyate | pārthivaṃ maṇḍalaṃ pītaṃ kaṭhinaṃ vajralāñchitam ||
hvā(hrā)mityātmīyabījena tannivṛttikalāmayam | taptacāmīkarākārā caturbāhuvibhūṣitā ||
vajrābhayākṣamālābjanivṛttiḥ parikīrtitaḥ | saṃyuktaṃ sayamantreṇa sātvikaṃ brahmadaivatam ||
pādāvārabhya mūrdhnāntaṃ vicintya caturaśrakam | udghātaṃ pañcakenaiva vāyubhūtaṃ viśodhayet ||
ardhacandradravaṃ saumyaṃ śubhramambhojalāñchitam | bījamityanena bījena pratiṣṭhārūpatāṃ gatam ||
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśamekavaktraṃ caturbhujam | (44ā) pāśābhayākṣamālābja pratiṣṭhā ratnabhūṣitā ||
saṃyuktaṃ vāmamantreṇa rājasaṃ viṣṇudaivatam | āpyaṃ caturbhirudghātairvahnibhūtaṃ viśodhayet ||
āgneyaṃ maṇḍantryaśraṃ raktaṃ svastikalāñchitam | hrāmityanena bījena vidyārūpaṃ vibhāvayet ||
piṅgabhrūśmaśruvṛttākṣacūḍācandravibhūṣitam | taptacāmīkarākāra vidyājvalanasannibham ||
aghoreṇasamāyuktaṃ tāmasaṃ rudradaivatam | vahniṃ ca tribhirudghātairjalabhūtaṃ viśodhayet ||
ṣaḍaśramaṇḍalaṃ vāyubindubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiraṅgitam | kṛṣṇaṃ vai miti bījena jātaṃ śāntikalāmayam ||
caturvaktraṃ caturbāhukṛṣṇavarṇamahābalā | dhvajābhayākṣamālābjā śāntissarpothavītinī ||
tatpuruṣeṇa saṃyuktamadhidevaṃ maheśvaram | sañcintyodghātayugmena prabdhi(hvī)bhūtaṃ viśodhayet ||
nabhobindumayaṃ bhūtaṃ binduśaktivibhūṣitam | vyomākāraṃ suvṛttaṃ ca śuddhasphaṭikanirmalam ||
haukāreṇa phaṭāntena śāntyatītakalāmayam | śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśā pañcavaktrā caturbhujā ||

āgneyyāṃ vyaktapātraṃ syāt nairṛtyāṃ sūryapātrakam | vāyossaṃyuktapātraṃ syāt pātrapūjā vidhīyate ||

śvetāyāṃ ca hare (tṛ)kṣīraṃ dhūmrāyā dadhi saṅgrahet | raktāyāṃ tu ghṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ pañcagavyakrameṇa tu ||
athavā ekavarṇaṃ tu saṅgraheddeśikottamaḥ | madhye kṣīraṃ trikuṭubaṃ pūrve prasthārthato dadhi ||

varadābhayahastāśca śivāsaktakarāmbujā | vibhāvyaivaṃ kesareṣu pūrvādīśānta keṣu ca ||
vidyeśānāmadhiṣṭhātrī vāmā jyeṣṭhādikā kramāt | śakti saṃpūjayedaṣṭau namo mudrāṃ pradarśayet ||
gokṣīradhavalāśakti īśāne ca manonmanīm | (57ā) dalāgre vṛttapadmasya sūryamaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ ||
padmasya kesarāgre ca vṛttake somamaṇḍale | viṣṇuścaturbhujo mau (---) śaṅkhacakragadābjadhṛk ||
nīlāmbujapratīkāśa somamaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ | padmasya karṇikāgre vai ragnimaṇḍalamarcayet ||
agnimadhye sthitaṃ rudraṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ trilocanam | sarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ nāgayajñopavītinam ||
padmasya karṇikāmadhye śaktimaṇḍalamarcayet | śakteśca maṇḍalāsīnaṃ vyālayajñopavītinam ||
candrārdhaśekharaṃ tryakṣaṃ śuddhasphaṭikanirmalam | khaḍgaṃ triśūlaṃ bāṇākṣamālābhayakarānvitam ||
kamaṇḍaludharaṃ devaṃ varāravindadhāriṇam | dakṣavāmakramāt sihmā gajacarmaparicchadam ||
kṣityādiśuddhavidyāntatattva vyāpakamāsanam | sañcintya deva deva (----) pūjayettadanantaram ||
candrajñāne (-)
anantaṃ pṛthivījñeyamā(mmā)pasihmāsanaṃ tathā | agniryogamidaṃ proktaṃ vāyuḥ padmaṃ tathaiva ca ||
ākāśaṃ vimalaṃ caiva pañcāsanavidhiṃ śṛṇu | sihmāsanaṃ catuṣkoṇamanantājñatrikoṇakam ||
padmañca vartulākāraṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vimalāsanam | (57B) yogāsanaṃ cāṣṭakoṇamāsanaṃ parikalpayet ||
yogaje (-)
anantākhyāsanaṃ pūrvaṃ sihmāsanamataḥ param | yogāsanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu turyaṃ padmāsanaṃ bhavet ||
pañcamaṃ vimalaṃ proktaṃ kalpayedupari kramāt |
suprabhede (-)
āvāhanāsanaṃ yogaṃ snāne sihmāsanaṃ bhavet | arcanāyāṃ mahāpadmaṃ vimalaṃ bhojanāsanam ||
anantākhyaṃ vinode syādetānvai parikalpayet |
kāraṇe (-)
ādhāraśaktipadmāntaṃ sthirāsanamiti smṛtam | yogapīṭhaṃ vibhāvaiva mūrttiṃ tasmin niveśayet ||
mūrtimīśvaratattvāntaṃ liṅganāhe tu vinyaset |
vātule (-)
aṣṭatriṃśat kalānyāsamātmārthapica yojayet | akārādi kṣakārāntaṃ mātrikā vinyaset tataḥ ||
evaṃ nyāstvā tato mantrī vidyādehaṃ prakalpayet | yā tasya vimalāśaktiḥ śivasya samapāyinī ||
saiva mūrtikriyābhedāt sadāśivatanurmatā | kṣatyādikuṭilā prāntā mantrasiṃhāsanasthitam ||
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ dvātriṃśallakṣaṇānvitam | pañcadīrghaṃ caturhrasvaṃ pañcasūkṣmaṃ ṣaḍunnatam ||
(58ā) saptaraktaṃ trigambhīraṃ dvau vistīrṇaṃ praśasyate | bāhunetrāntaraṃ caiva jānu nāsā tathaiva ca ||
stanayorantaraṃ caiva pañcadīrghaṃ praśasyate | grīvā pūjānana pṛṣṭhaṃ hrasvajaṅghā praśasyate ||
sūkṣmāṇyaṅgulaparvāṇi keśadantanakhāni ca | kakṣaṃ kukṣiśca vakṣaśca ghrāṇaskandhā lalāṭikā ||
pāṇipādādharoṣṭhaṃ ca jihvā cakṣastvaca śruti | svaraṃ satvaṃ ca nābhiśca trigambhīraśca praśasyate ||
śiro lalāṭikā caiva dvau vistīrṇaṃ praśasyate | padmāsanasthaṃ pañcāsyaṃ prativaktraṃ trilocanam ||
(---) kriyaiścā viśālākṣaṃ jñānacandrakalānvitam | dhavaleśānavadanaṃ pītaṃ tatpuruṣānanam ||
kṛṣṇāghoramukhopeta raktābhottara vaktrakam | suśvetaṃ paścimāsyaikaṃ sadyojātaṃ prakīrtitam ||
nāgopavītinaṃ śāntaṃ jaṭākhaṇḍendumaṇḍitam | divyagandhānuliptāṅgaṃ divyamālāvibhūṣitam ||
śaktyāsiśūlakhaṭvāṅgaṃ varavyagrakarāmbujam | dakṣiṇāto'tha vāmasthai ḍamarubdījapūrakam ||
nāgākṣasūtranīlābjaṃ bibhrāṇaṃ pañcabhiḥ karaiḥ | (59B) sañcintya mūrtayet rūpaṃ śaktimātrabijṛmbhaṇam ||
liṅgākāropamardena bhāvane liṅgatāṃ tyajet | niṣkalaṃ svaprakāraṃ ca sañcintya paramaṃ śivam ||
brahmādikāraṇatyāgānmantraṃ nītvā śivāspadam |
jñānaratnāvalyām (-)
akāraśca ukāraśca makāro bindureva ca | ardhacandranirodhī ca nādo nādānta eva ca ||
saśaktiśca vyāpinīvyomarūpiṇī (*?dva)vanantakam | anaśritāvanantā ca samanāconmanā tathā ||
samānāntaṃ pāśajālamunmanyante paraśśivaḥ | tato lalāṭamadhyasthaṃ sphurantārāpratiprabham ||
brahmāṅgena samākīrṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ bindurūpakam | puṣpāñjaligataṃ dhyātvā lakṣyamūrtau niveśayet ||
āvāhinyā hṛdāvāhya sthāpinyā sthāpyaśaṅkaram | sannidhānāntikaṃ kṛtvā niṣṭhūrākhyā nirodhayet |
suprabhede (-)
ācāryasadyamantreṇa sthāpayet guṇyamantrataḥ | bahurūpeṇa sānnidhyaṃ puruṣeṇa nirodhayet ||
(59B) sarvāvayavasampūrṇamīśāne (na) tu bhāvayet |
somaśambhau (-)
sādaraṃ sammukhībhāvamāvāhanamihocyate | bhaktyā niveśanaṃ tatra sthāpanaṃ kathitaṃ budhaiḥ ||
jagannātha tavāsmīti yassvīkāropi darśanāt | vibhūtve'pitaśasya sannidhānaṃ na bādhyate ||
ākarmakāṇḍaparyanta sannidheryo parikṣayaḥ | sa śambhorvyāpakatve vinirorga parigīyate ||
sakalīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā mantraiṣṣaḍbhirathaikatām | kālakaṇṭhyāpi santena vighnānuccāṭya muṣṭinā ||
liṅgamudrā namaskāraṃ hṛdā baddhā'vakuṇḍayet | śivasyānandabījasya bodhānandamayasya ca ||
abhakteṣvaprakāśo yastadbhāvedavakuṇḍanam | aṅgānāmaṅginā sāmyaṃ vidaddhyādamṛtīkṛtam ||
ato nivaddhiyenmudrānnoparibhrāmayetkaram |
śrīmanmṛgendra (-)
īṣṭe yena jagatsarvaṃ guṇenoparivartinā | samūrdhvasamadeśatvāt mūrdhnānāvayavastanoḥ ||
tasya tasya tanuryā (---) stasyāmupiti yena saḥ | tantrāṇāṃ cātmanaścāpi(-ccāpi-)statpuruṣeṇavaktrakaḥ ||
(59B) hṛdayāmbodhaparyāyassosyāghoraśśivo yataḥ | parigṛhasya ghoratvāt ravorottirupacārataḥ ||
vāmastrivargasāmatvadruhasyatrasvabhāvataḥ | vāmaṃ dhāma paraṃ guhyaṃ yasyāsau vāmaguhyakaḥ ||
sadyoṇunā mamūrtayassambhavanti yasyecchā tastenassadyo'bhidhānaḥ | sadyomūrtiyogināṃ vā vidhatte sadyomūrtiṃ kṛtya śaighnāntaghrāntamūrteḥ ||
hṛdayaṃ tasya cicchaktiḥ śriraścaiśvaryamaṣṭadhā | nānyādhīnaṃ śivatvaṃ yat sā śivoparivartini ||
abhedaṃ parameśasya jeḥ kavacamiṣyate | pratāpo dussahaścāstrāmantarāyāpahārakam ||
sarvajñatā tṛptiranādibodha svatantratānityamaluptaśakti | anantaśaktiśca vibhoranujñāṣṣaḍāhuraṅgāni maheśvarasya ||
aṣṭatriṃśatkalopeto vyaktissadāśivaḥ | sakalastu bhaveddevamanyathā niṣkalāśśivaḥ ||
āhūdaya svanāmnā tu janassannihito bhavet |
tathā mantraprayogeṇa tantrasannihitaśśivaḥ | yathā kāṣṭhagato vahniḥvyajyate mathanādibhiḥ ||
(60ā) tathā mantraprabhāvena bhaktyā'bhivyajyate śivaḥ |
āmūlāgragatau (-)
svāmin sarvajagannātha yāvat pūjāvasānakam | tāvat saṃ(tvaṃ) prīti bhāvena liṅge'smin sannidhībhava ||
āvāhane tanmūrti dravati dravahemavat |
aṃśumati (-)
tasmādāvāhane kāle cārghyaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ | pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ dūrvā puṣpākṣatādikam ||
susvāgatakriyāpūrvamapi kalpena kalpayet |
somaśambhau (-)
namassvadhā(ca) svādhā ca vauṣaḍantu yathākramam | hṛtpurassaramuccārya pādyādīni nivedayet ||
pādyaṃ pādāmbujadvandve vaktreṣvācamanīyakam | arghyaṃ śirasi devasya pūṣpadūrvākṣatāni ca |
pādyaṃ śivapadaprāptiraṃhlāta (-rāhlāda) mācamaṃ bhavet | śivatvavyaktisāmpādyairātmanorghyaṃ śivasya tu ||
sthirāsane namāvāhya mānasaṃ snānamācaret | tatpīṭhaṃ vāmahastena sparśayedastramantrataḥ ||
navapuṣpaṃ tu saṅgṛhya tatpuruṣantu visarjayet | mantratoyābhiṣekānte mantrapuṣpaṃ tu dāpayet ||
mantrapuṣpaṃ tato dattvā mantrānnaṃ ca nivedayet | (60B) agnerdīpanamevaṃ ca śamanārthaṃ nivedyakam ||
mantraṃ rahasyamityuktaṃ madanādānnamucyate | rahasyadyotanaṃ caiva mantrānnamiti kathyate ||
tathāṃśumati (-)
śivamantramanusmṛtya gandhapuṣpaṃ nyasettataḥ | golakāghṛtavārī ca makuṭaṃ caiva yojayet ||
karakaṅkaṇahārādyairnānāratnairvibhūṣayet | dravyālābhe manāsīkṛ(tu)dātavyau ghṛtarūpiṇī ||
vātule (-)
dukūlapaṭṭadevāṅgaiścitravastraṃ tathā'pi vā | atha kārpāsavastrairvā śuddhiṃ kṛtvā tu saṅgrahet ||
purāṇaṃ chinnaṃ tathā sphoṭamāghadaṣaṃ ca varjayet | pūrvāhne sitavastraṃ tu madhyāhne raktavastrakam ||
pītavastraṃ tu sāyāhne sandhyāyāme tu sarvataḥ (ka) |
śivadharme (-)
vāsāṃsi su vicitrāṇi sākhāntimudīni ca | śuddhāni ca nivedadyāt vikeśāni navāni ca ||
yāvattadvastra tantūnāṃ parimāṇaṃ vidhīyate | tāvadvarṣa sahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate ||
kāraṇe (-)
kavacenopavītaṃ syāt vastraṃ vai hṛdayena tu | (61ā) trivṛtaṃ śuklapītaṃ vā paṭṭasūtrādinirmitam ||
yajñopavītaṃ rudrāya datvā vedāntato(go) bhavet |
suprabhede (-)
kuṅkumāgarukarpūrakastūrīcandanādikān | himāmbunābhitailaṃ ca kastūrī yakṣakardamān ||
liṅgasya lepanaṃ kuryāt divyagandhaissugandhibhiḥ |
gorocanākuṅkumacandanairva karpūrakṛṣṇāgaru devakāṣṭhaiḥ | kastūrikādyairabhilipya śambhuṃ prāpnotu puṇyaṃ hayamedhakoṭyām (ḥ) ||
gandhānulepanāt puṇyaṃ dviguṇaṃ candanasya tu | candanādagarurjñeyaṃ puṇyamaṣṭaguṇādhikam ||
kṛṣṇāgajñerviśeṣeṇa dviguṇaṃ phalamiṣyate | tasmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kuṅkumasya vidhīyate ||
devadārumayaṃ gandhaṃ śivāya vinivedayet | śivalokamavāpnoti kalpamekaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
bilvamūlamayaṃ gandhamumāmaheśvarāya vai | mahadaiśvaryamāpnoti tadante śivapuraṃ vrajet ||
āraśvadhamayaṃ gandhaṃ libe(pye?)mṛtyuñjayonaraḥ | mṛtyujit sa bhavedbhakto gāṇāpatyamavāpnuyāt ||
(61 B)śivasyo (----) t sarvaratnopaśobhitam | makuṭaṃ ghṛtavārī va tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu ||
koṭikoṭivimānaiśca sarvakāmasamanvitaiḥ | abhūtaṃ saṃplavaṃ yāvat āste śivapure sukhī ||
tuṭimātraṃ tu yo dadyāt hemaliṅgasya mūrdhni vai | indrasyādhvāsanaṃ yāvat tāvadindrāścaturdaśaḥ ||
evaṃ vittānusāreṇa phalaṃ jñeyasamāśritaḥ |
suprabhede (-)
māṇikkamarkavāre tu candravāre tu mauktikam | pravālaṃ kujavāre tu budhe maratakaṃ dadet ||
gure(rau) ca puṣyarāgaṃ syā śukre vajramiti smṛtam | indranīlaṃ śanivāre (mandavāre) sarvāṇyetāni yāni ca ||
sarvavāreṣu yogyāni bhūṣaṇānāṃ vidhirmataḥ | tadvārṇāni ca puṣpāṇi vastrāṇi ca viyojayet ||
pūjābhāgaṃ tu vaikāśaṃmekāṃśaṃ vastraveṣṭanam | vastramābharaṇairbhūṣyamekāṃśaṃ puṣpaśobhitam ||
ātmatattvaṃ nyasetsavye vidyātattvaṃ tu vāmake | madhyame śivatattvaṃ tu kalpayet kalpavittamaḥ ||
śivadharme (-)
puṣpairāraṇyasambhūtaiḥ patrairvā girisambhavaiḥ | aparyuṣitaniśchidraiḥ prokṣitairjantuvarjitaiḥ ||
ātmārdrarāmāddhalairvāpi puṣpaissaṃpūjayet śivam | mallikotpalapadmāni jātīpunnāgacampakaiḥ ||
aśokaśvetamandāraiḥ karṇikāra bakāni ca | karavīrārkamandāra śamī tagarakesaraiḥ ||
kuśāpāmārgakusumaiḥ kadambadroṇajairapi | sitakāñcanadhurdhūraistathā lohitakāñcanaḥ ||
palāśaḥ pāṭalītyeṣā praśastā prasavādṛtā (-mṛtā) | bilvaṃ tulasi dhurdhūraṃ kalhāraṃ hemapuṣpakam ||
devasya śiravinyastaṃ kṣālayettu punaḥ punaḥ | tulasīvatsarāntassyāt bilvaṃ ṣāṇmāsakaṃ tathā ||
padmaṃ dvādaśa māsaṃ tu anyapuṣpai ku(stu)vārakam | bilvāpāmārgakaṃ cūto damano maruvorjunaḥ ||
nandyāvartaśca śamyarka tilakastanamallikā | saugandhikāsanāmasti sindhukeśamālikārjunaiḥ (sindu-) ||
dūrvātalaśikhākolo gaurīsurabhikā śamī | muṇḍakāntāramadano bhṛṅgāraḥ paribhadrakaḥ ||
(62B) jambūkuśāgra ityete praśastāḥ patrasaṅgrahaḥ | pūrvoktakusumālābhe patrairetaiśśivaṃ yajet ||
patrāṇāmapyalābhe tu phalaiścāpi prapūjayet | bījāpūraiśca jambīraiḥ kadalīḍāḍimīśubhaiḥ ||
phalaṃ tṛptikaraṃ sadyaḥ phalairabhyarcayecchivam | tulasī bilvapatraṃ ca hemapuṣpaṃ ca mauktikam ||
trisandhyaṃ pūjayelliṅgaṃ prakṣākṣyaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ | arkavāre tu bilvaṃ syāt tulasī somavārake ||
aṅgāre ca kapitthaṃ syāt mātulaṅgaṃ budhe tathā | bṛhaspatidāntavaṃ caiva bhārgave jambupatrakam ||
śanaiścare viṣṇukrānti syādvāre patramihocyate | yaistairvāpi kusumairjalasthalaruhaiśśivam ||
sampūjya prokṣitairbhaktyā śivaloke mahīyate | svayamutpādya puṣpāṇi yaśśivaṃ samyagarcayet ||
tānisarvān pragṛhṇāti yadbhaktyā satataṃ śivaḥ | uttamārāmapuṣpāṇi madhyamaṃ vanasambhavam ||
adhamaṃ vikrayaṃ caiva yācakaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet | (63ā) arkapuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ karavīraṃ viśiṣyate ||
puṣpajātiṣu sarveṣu karavīraṃ viśiṣyate | tasya madhye sthitaṃ devaṃ liṅgapīṭhaprakārataḥ ||
tatpuṣpaṃ hemapuṣpaṃ ca pūjāyāṃ vatsarairyutam | nirmālyaṃ na bhavettatra iti śāstrasya niścayaḥ ||
ekena karavīreṇa basiṃ vāsitameva ca | nīlakaṇṭhaṃ samabhyarcya kulakoṭiṃ samuddharet ||
karavīrasahasrebhyo bilvapatraṃ viśiṣyate | icchājñānakriyāśakti bilvapatratrayaṃ viduḥ ||
darśanāt bilvapatrasya sparśanādvandanādapi | ahorātrakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naśyate nātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
śuṣkaiḥ paryuṣitaiḥ patrairapi bilvasya nāradaḥ | pūjayet girijānāthā (-thaṃ) mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||
bilvapatrairakhaṇḍaiśca sakṛlliṅgaṃ prapūjayet | sarvapāpavinirmuktaśśivaloke mahīyate ||
kīṭakādīni doṣastu lūtasūtraṃ vivarjayet |
kundākhyapatraṃ śukapatrayuktaṃ bilvaṃ ca nirguṇṭhikapitthapatram | etāni pañcāni ca bilvapatram vyomavyamantreṇa śivārcayeti ||
(63B) bilvapatrasahasrebhyaḥ padmamekaṃ viśiṣyate | padmapuṣpasahasrebhyo bakapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate ||
bakapuṣpasahasrebhya ekaṃ durdhūrakaṃ viduḥ | dhurdhūrakasahasrebhyaśśrīmannīlotpalaṃ varam ||
sarveṣāṃ puṣpajātīnāṃ pravaraṃ nīlamutpalam | nīlotpalaṃ tataḥ paścāt bṛhatpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate ||
bṛhatpuṣpasahasrebhyoḥ droṇapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate | droṇapuṣpasahasrebhya apāmārgaṃ viśiṣyate ||
apāmārgasahasrebhyaḥ kuśapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate | kuśapuṣpasahasrebhyaśśrīmannīlotpalaṃ varam ||
sarveṣāṃ puṣpajātīnāṃ pravaraṃ nīlamutpalam | nīlotpalasamaṃ puṣpaṃ na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ||
nīlotpalasahasrebhyo bhaktirekā viśiṣyate | śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā nīlaṃ sātvikādīni tāni (yāni) ca ||
puṣpāṇi pītavarṇāni miśrakāni vinirdiśet | nīlotpalaṃ vinā'nyāni tāmasāni vivarjayet ||
nandyāvartaśriyāvartaṃ śvetārkamudaye dadet | (64ā) karavīraṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca droṇaṃ madhyāhnage hitam ||
mallikā kṛṣṇadurdhūraṃ sāyāhne campakaṃ hitam | kadambakanakājāti dvikarṇī cārdharātrake ||
droṇaṃ ca śvetapadmaṃ ca jātīcambahukarṇikā | nandyāvartaṃ śriyāvartaṃ mandāraṃ śatapatrikā ||
śvetārka mālatī bilvaṃ punnāgaṃ kuravaṃ tathā | evamādīni puṣpāṇi sātvikāni vinirdiśet ||
raktotpalaṃ tathāpadmaṃ durdhūraṃ bṛhatīdvayam | palāśapāṭalādīni rājasāni vinirdiśet ||
kālottare (-)
karaṃ ca vakulaṃ kāśaṃ śirīṣaṃ ketakī tathā | lāṅgalī ḍāḍimīṃ jāpaṃ śrīparṇī ca vibhītakam ||
bandhūkakundayūthāni kārpāsaṃ nimbakaṇṭakam | kiṃśukaṃ ca madantī ca kumudāni vivarjayet ||
apakvamatipakvaṃ ca mukulaṃ ca vivarjayet | keśa kīṭopaviddhāni lutasūtrāvṛtāni ca ||
svayaṃ (pa)titapuṣpāṇi saṃyatānyavivastrake | ekāhoṣitapuṣpāṇi tyajedupahatāni ca ||
nārcayedakṣatairviṣṇuṃ na tulasyā vināyakam | (64B) na dūrvayā maheśānaṃ ketakyā meheśvaram ||
nirgandhānyugragandhāni kusumāni vivarjayet |
suprabhede (-)
utsavādiṣu yātrāyāṃ pariveṣakriyāsu ca | sakalaṃ nāmalaṅkāre varjyā grāhyaśca sarvadā ||
kālottare (-)
kṛṣṇakāni ca puṣpāṇi mahiṣākṣī ca puṣpakā (-kam) | śiṃśumārakapuṣpāṇi umādevīṃ prapūjayet ||
devārāmodbhavaṃ puṣpaṃ grahadevāya nārcayet | sugandhairyuktapuṣpairvā sau(sa)myak liṅgaṃ prapūjayet ||
mālābhirvā sughaṭitai a (na)ntaphalamāpnuyāt | mālābhirveṣṭayeceti liṅgaṃ sampūjayennaraḥ ||
śivo devyā ca putreṇa modate pūjate naye | laṅgaṃ vedi bhaveddevi liṅgaṃ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ ||
tayorusaṃpūjanasyātā devīdevasya pūjitau | śivasyopari yaḥ kuryāt sukhanaṃ puṣpamaṇṭapam ||
śobhitaṃ puṣpamālādyairāpīṭhāntaṃ pralambibhiḥ | atyāścaryamahāyānairdivyapuṣpopaśobhitaiḥ ||
sarvaiḥ parivṛtaśśrīmān sagacchet śivapuraṃ sukhī | (65ā) patrachedaistu sampūjā rākṣasānāṃ vināśinī ||
puṣpachedaistu sampūjā sarvasiddhikarī bhavet | layāṅgaṃ pūrvamabhyarcya śivabrahmāṅgakaistataḥ ||
somaśambhau (-)
praṇakyādāya devajñāṃ bhogāṅgāni prapūjayet |
jñānaratnāvalyām (-)
ātmanaśśivaṣāṅguṇya prāptibhogāṅgamarcanam | aṅgānāṃ punaraikyaṃ ca śivasaṃyogamātmanaḥ ||
īśānamīśapatre ca pūrvapatre naraṃ yajet | aghoraṃ dakṣiṇe patre vāmadevaṃ tathottare ||
ajāntaṃ paścime patre hṛdayaṃ vahnipatrake | īśānapatraśiraścūṭānairṛte kavacaṃ marut ||
netramīśe caturdikṣu hetirājaṃ ca bhūṣaṇam |
vijaye (-)
pañca brahma ṣaḍaṅgāni devasya paritaḥ sthitaḥ | vaktrebhyastattadaṅgebhyaḥ dīpāddīpamivāharet ||
sphaṭikābhaṃ jagaddhetu triṇetraṃ candramaulinam | saumyaṃ prasannamīśānaṃ triśūlābhayapāṇinam ||
pītāmbaropavītaṃ ca naraṃ kanakasannibham | mātulaṅgā sūtre ca dadhānaṃ candramaulinam ||
tryakṣaṃ maulīndradṛk saumyaṃ kuṇḍalālaṅkṛtaṃ tataḥ | (65B) babhruśmaśruśirojaṃ ca daṃṣṭrā vikaṭānanam ||
kapālamālābharaṇaṃ sarpavṛścikabhūṣaṇam | khaṭvāṅgaṃ japakālaṃ ca kheṭakaṃ pāśameva ca ||
vāmahastacatuṣkoṇaṃ dakṣahastacatuṣṭaye | triśūlaṃ paraśuṃ khaḍgaṃ daṇḍaṃ caivāri mardanam ||
evaṃ navāmbudābhāsamaghoraṃ sarvakāmadam | vāmaṃ raktasuraktābhaṃ nālyavastropavītinam ||
tuṅganāsāruṇoṣṇīṣaṃ khaḍgakheṭakapāṇinam | sitāsragandhabhūṣāḍhyaṃ sitoṣṇīṇaṃ sitāmbaram ||
saumyamaulīndusampannaṃ bālākāraṃ trilocanam | sadyojātaṃ sitāsyaikaṃ varadābjabhayānakam ||
īnānādinisavyāntamevaṃ dhyātvā'rcayet sadā | dhenupadmaṃ triśūlaṃ ca makaraṃ ca makaraṃ ca sragākhyakam ||
īśānādikrameṇaiva pañcamudrāṃ pradarśayet | īśānasyottare bhāge netraṃ saṃpūjayet tataḥ ||
aruṇābhasma(aruṇābhastra-)raṃ netraṃ dṛk kriyaiścātmakā vibhoḥ | tritadvarūpaṃ vanyādimaṇḍalaṃ tritayaśritam ||
hṛdādyaṅgoktavadanaṃ karadhāryādisaṃyutam | (66ā) ekāsyaṃ vā triśūlābhihastaṃ yogaśivoktitaḥ ||
agnaśāstrapapāyūnāṃ dikṣu catvāryanukramāt |
kālottare (-)
hṛdayaṃ candrasaṅkāśaṃ śiraścāmīkaraprabham | śikhāsindūravarṇāḍhyā kavacaṃ bhṛṅgabhāsvaram ||
netraṃ vidyutpratīkāśamastramagnisamaprabham | padmāsanasthānardhendujaṭāmakuṭadhāriṇam ||
trilocanāṃścaturbāhūn sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitān | śivasyābhimukheśaktiśūlābhayakarānvitān ||
daṃṣṭrākarālamatyugramastraṃ cāgnisamaprabham | hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgānāṃ namomudrāṃ pradarśayet ||
eteṣāṃ śaktayaḥ (-)
ambī gaṇāmbī gaṅgā ca gaurī caiva umā tathā | nābhi nīlī ca cakrāṅgī pāśāṅgī khaḍgagāmbikā ||
kamalālaye (-)
garbhāvaraṇamevaṃ tu vidyeśāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇu | ananteśastathā sūkṣmaḥ śivoktamekanetrakaḥ ||
ekarudrastrimūrtiśca śrīkaṇṭhaśca śikhaṇḍinaḥ | aṣṭa vidyeśvarāhyete triṇetrāśca caturbhujā ||
abhayavaradopetaṃ ṭaṅkaśūlakarastathā | (66B) raktaṃ kundaṃ tathā nīlaṃ phītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca kuṅkumam ||
aruṇaṃ tvañjanaṃ prākhyaṃ kramādvidyeśavarṇakam | jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyukta mupavīta samanvitam ||
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ śāntavaktrasamanvitam | bhūmisvagahā svadhā kṣāntiprabhāpuṣṭiśrutistathā ||
medhā māyā tathā cāṣṭau vidyeśānāṃ tu śaktayaḥ | anantādiśikhaṇḍāntaṃ pūrvādikramaśo yajet ||
vidyeśāvaraṇaṃ hyevaṃ gaṇeśāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇu | nandīśvaramahākalau bhṛṅgī gaṇapatistathā ||
vṛṣabhaḥ kārtikeyaśca pārvatīcaṇḍanāyakaḥ | caturbhujastriṇetrastu nandīśaśśyāmavarṇakaḥ ||
abhayavaradopeto daṇḍaśūladharograkaḥ | mahākālastriṇetrastu kṛṣṇavarṇaścaturbhujaḥ ||
abhayavaradopetamagraśūlastu tomaraḥ | caturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca bhṛṅgīśaṃ piṅgalaprabham ||
dakṣiṇe'bhayaṭaṅkaṃ tu vāme varadaśūladhṛk | gajānanaṃ triṇetraṃ ca kuṅkumābhaṃ caturbhujam ||
pāśadantau tu saumye tu vāmetvaṅkuśalaḍḍukam | nāgayajñopavītaṃ tu bimboṣṭhaṃ ca gaṇādhipam ||
(67ā) vṛṣabhaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ tu rakāra sarve khurā mṛ(smṛ?) tāḥ(?)| sitakṛṣṇamayī cākṣī dvau śṛṅgau raktavarṇakau ||
karṇau ca raktavarṇābhau bālā pītena śobhitā | khaṇḍā(pāṇā) mālā suvarṇābhā sthitaṃ vāsayitantu vā ||
raktavarṇo mahāseno dvinetrāśca caturbhujāḥ | sevyetvabhiyavajraṃ tu vāme ca varadāṅkuśau ||
dvinetrā dvibhujā śyāmā gaurī dakṣakarotpalā | dvinetradvibhujaścaṇḍaśyāmā vai ṭaṅkahastakaḥ ||
bhadrā ca devayonī ca kundī kālī ca mantriṇī | mālānī ca umācaiva yaminī caṇḍāntaśaktayaḥ ||
pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ krameṇaiva tu saṃyajet |
suprabhede (-)
vidyeśānāṃ gaṇeśānāṃ kālakarṇi dudarśayet | gaṇeśāvaraṇaṃ hyevaṃ lokeśāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇu ||
indraścāgniryamaścaiva nirṛtirvaruṇavāyavaḥ | somaścaiva tathaiśānalokapālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
vajrapāṇirmahāvīrassahasrākṣo viśālabhṛt | lalāṭorastayo dhāma pīvārorurmahodaraḥ ||
(67B) prasannavadanaśśyāmāvarṇo raktāmbarassukhi | kirīṭa kuṇḍalā hārakeyūrādivibhūṣitaḥ ||
pṛthugrānī gajārūḍho devarājaśśacīpatiḥ | ardhacandramajāsīno vṛddharūpo hutāśanaḥ ||
taruṇādityasaṅkāśaṃ tadvaktramupavītakam | daṇḍapāṇirmahādīpto kālāñjanasapraśchaviḥ ||
mahāmaṣiṣa mārūḍho dīptāgnisamalocanaḥ | rākṣaseśo viśālākṣo pītavastraśśavāsanaḥ ||
sunṛtissusthitāsīnaḥ khaḍgahasto mahābalaḥ | keyūrakuṇḍalāhāri pītavāsassuśobhanaḥ ||
āsīnā vā sthito vā'pi makare varuṇassthitaḥ | kuñcitabhrū yuvā vāyustāmradṛk dhūmrasannibhaḥ ||
mṛgārūḍho vidhātavyo sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitaḥ | evaṃ sadāgatissarvaṃ vyāpakoyaṃ samīraṇaḥ ||
yakṣarājakuberoyaṃ taptakāñcanasannibham | śaṅkhapadmanidhiryukto gatahasto nidhīśvaraḥ ||
vṛṣārūḍhamahātejo dhavalaḥ piṅgalekṣaṇaḥ | triśūlapāṇirīśāna triṇetrā lokaśaṅkaraḥ ||
(68ā) śacīpulomajā devī svāhāvatī tathāvubhau | kālakarṇī ca nīlī ca nārīcasusuketanī ||
pūrvādīśānaparyantaṃ krameṇaiva tu saṃyajet | caturmukhaṃ caturbāhukamanḍalyakṣa dhāriṇaḥ ||
sruvaṃ dakṣiṇahaste tu pātākāvāmahastake | ambhojanakāsīno brahmāṇaṃ homasammukham ||
viṣṇuścaturbhujo maukti śaṅkhacakragatābjadhṛk | nīlāmbudapratīkāśo garuḍāsanasaṃsthitaḥ ||
īśānaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge brahmāṇaṃ ca prapūjayet | nairṛteruttare bhāge viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjayet kramāt ||
lokeśāvaraṇaṃ hyevamastreśāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇu | vajraṃ śaktiśca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśāṅkuśastathā ||
gatā triśūlacakraṃ ca padmaṃ caiva daśāyudham | dvibhujā ca dvinetrāśca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||
kṛtāñjalipuṭopetaḥ karaṇḍamakuṭānvitaḥ | tattadvaktrapramāṇena (--) stramūrdhni samanvitaḥ ||
nānāvarṇamahāvidyut nīlajīmūtanīlakam | (68B) pāvanaṃ padmarāgaṃ ca tuṣāraṃ cendranīlakam ||
śaradāmraṃ ca śaktaṃ ca vajrādīnāṃ tu varṇakam |
kāmike (-)
jāyāśaktigate vidyāt pāśapadmau napuṃsakau | śeṣāḥ pumāniti khyātaḥ kīrtitāstvastramūrtayaḥ ||
lokeśānāṃ tathā'strāṇāṃ śūlamudrāṃ pradarśayet | hrādinī hāriṇī caiva ariṣṭī maṅginī tathā ||
ṛddhā caiva niṛddhā ca jatakāśīsvarūpiṇī | astraśaktiriti proktamarcayeddevasannidhau ||
vidyeśvarā dalāgreṣu pīṭhaṃ kaṇṭhe gaṇeśvaraḥ | pīṭhapāde tu lokeśaḥ tadastrāṇi śivopari ||
tantrasāre (-)
brahmāṅganānāṃ prathamāvarāṇāṃ
vidyeśvarāṇāṃ ca gaṇeśvarāṇām |
dikpālakānāṃ ca daśāyudhānāṃ
īśasya pañcāvaraṇakrameṇa ||
paścāt śivāya mūlena datvā puṣpāñjalitrayam | mahāmudrāṃ darśayitvā bhaktyā sarveśvarāya ca ||
somaśambhau (-)
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ toyamācamanīyakam | karodvartanatāmbūlaṃ mukhavāsaṃ ca darpaṇam ||
(69ā) dadyāt saparivārāya mūlamantreṇa śambhave |
kamalālaye (-)
devānāmarcane kāle pracchinnapaṭamuttamam | vedavikrayakaiścaiva granthavikrayakairapi ||
pāpakṣura(-kṣudra?) paribhraṣṭanāstikaiḥ śrutidūṣakaiḥ | duścarmakuṣṭhasaṃyuktaiḥ śivadravyāpahāribhiḥ ||
(----) rudravyāpahārī ca gurudrohī ca pātakaiḥ | pramādāddarśanaṃ kṛtvā pūjāyāṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet ||
tasmāt pūjādikāle tu naivedyocābhiṣecane | evamādīni kāle tu pracchinnapaṭamārabhet ||
kāmike (-)
śālīnāṃ taṇḍulaśreṣṭho yavavrīhyādikanyasam | brīhīnāmeva śiṣṭānāṃ taṇḍulāścādhamaṃ bhavet ||
sitataṇḍulakāye ca te sarve śāla smṛtaḥ | itare vrīhyaḥ proktāḥ phalaṃ teṣāṃ pṛthakpṛthak |
itare kaphalaṃ caiva śalirdaśaguṇaṃ bhavet | priyaṅguśca tathā proktā nīvārāṃ tu sahasrakam ||
godhūmaṃ tu bhavelladāmanantaṃ vaiṇavaṃ bhavet | bhaktyā vittānusāreṇa naivedyaṃ tu prakalpayet ||
(69B) patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyamannapānādyamauṣadham | anivedyaṃ na bhuñjīta bhagavantaṃ sadāśivam |
apūpakādi yaddravyaṃ bhojyaṃ dattvā śivasya tu | vardhate tasya taddhānyaṃ phalapuṣpādayastathā ||
adatvā tu rahasyātha (rahasyeṇa) bhuktaṃ tu kṣīyatedhanam | yāvantastaṇḍulāstatra naivedyamapi kalpite ||
tadvarṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate | sūkṣe (sūkṣme) (-)
dviprasthādi caturdroṇamātmārthe saṃprapūjayet |
aṃśumati (-)
uttamaṃ dvayāḍhakaṃ proktaṃ ṣaṭprasthaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavet | adhamaṃ cāḍhakaṃ caiva naivedyaṃ trividhaṃ bhavet ||
athavā'nyaprakāreṇa āḍhakaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet | uttamāditrayaṃ caiva kuḍubāntaṃ taducyate ||
prasthārthaphalaṃ caiva kuḍubārdhaghṛtaṃ tathā | tadardhārdhaghṛtaṃ caiva puṣpeṇaiva tu yojayet ||
ājyahīnaṃ tu naivedyamasurāṇāṃ nivedyakam | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena ājyayuktaṃ nivedayet ||
kāraṇe (-)
caru prasthadvayaṃ proktaṃ havirāḍhakamucyate | prasthaṃ kuḍubasaṃyuktaṃ paiśācāśanamucyate ||
prāgupta(-kta)vidhinā pūrvaṃ snātvā tu paricārakaḥ | śuklavastradharāścaiva śuklayajñopavītinaḥ ||
pavitrapāṇinā kuryāt carupakvamethakramam | vastrapūtaiśca toyeśca jaladroṇiṃ prapūrayet ||
pātraśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kṣālayet taṇḍulān hṛdā | jalenaiva tu ṣaṭ kṛtvā niṣpīḍya ca muhurmuhuḥ ||
kāmike (-)
ṣaḍaṅgaiḥ kṣālanaṃ kṛtvā sadyena prakṣipet jalam |
kāraṇe (-)
taṇḍulasya pramāṇasya ardhādhikasamaṃ jalam | pralipte gomayādyaistu prokṣite tatra mānase ||
dharmādharmabhujān dyukti taṇḍulai ravayeddhadā (-tā) | uddhṛtya vāmadevena sthāpayeddhṛdayena tu ||
vinyasyāgnimaghoreṇa vajreṇagniṃ pradīpayet | pipīlikādisañjuṣṭhaiḥ koṭaraḥ prakṛtisaṃyutaiḥ ||
visphuliṅgayutaiścāpi kāṣṭhaiścāpina dīpayet | tuṣeṇa dāridryaṃ caiva pāṣāṇaṃ vyādhireva ca ||
keśakīṭāpaviddhaṃ ca śarkarātuṣasaṃyutam | atipakvamapakvaṃ ca naivedyaṃ parivarjayet ||
ājyaṃ tu varṇagandhābhyāṃ śītalānnaṃ nivedayet |
sāntāne (-)
tuṣeṇa dāridrya yuñcaiva pāṣāṇaṃ vyādhireva ca | keśena maraṇaṃ vidyāt varjayettu viśeṣataḥ ||
haviśca ṣaḍvidhaṃ deyaṃ śuddhaṃ mudgānnameva ca | pāyasaṃ dadhisaṃyuktaṃ gaulaṃ ca madhunārpitam ||
dadhimiśraṃ gulairmiśraṃ madhusaṃmiśrakaṃ haviḥ | eteṣveka manekaṃ vā vyañjanena samanvitam ||
vīratantre (-)
pāyasānnakramaṃ vakṣye mudgaṃ vai taṇḍulārdhakam | taṇḍulārdhaṃ gulaṃ proktamājyaṃ caiva gulārdhakam ||
gulānnamiti vijñeyaṃ kṛsarānnamatha śṛṇu | tilā vai cūrṇitaṃ tatra taṇḍulasya caturthakam ||
tilārthaṃ prakṣipedājyaṃ kṛsarānnamihocyate | taṇḍulasya caturbhāgaṃ mudgaṃ tatraiva yojayet ||
nālikeraphalairyuktaṃ mudgānnaṃ yadi hocyate | (71ā) śuddhodanasahasrebhyaḥ pāyasaṃ ca viśiṣyate ||
pāyasānnasahasrebhyaḥ kṛsarānnaṃ viśiṣyate | kṛsarānnasahasrebhyo gaulānnaṃ ca viśiṣyate ||
gaulānna(syānnāṃ) sahasrebhyo mudgānnaṃ tu viśiṣyate |
vātule (-)
kūśmāṇḍa phanasā lāpukalaṅkaṃ bṛhatīdvayam | trayuṣaṭkarkarī caiva satuṣaṃ vituṣaṃ tathā ||
ekaika mukpadarśānāṃ prasthasyekaphalaṃ bhavet | śiśumūlaṃ vallimūlaṃ kandamūlaṃ ca sūraṇam ||
amṛtaṃ ca tintriṇī tatra yathālābhaṃ gṛhet gṛhā | sarvopadaṃśakāyuktaṃ marīcīlavaṇānvitāḥ ||
jīrakādisamopeta yathāyogaṃ pacet pṛthak |
cintyaviśve (-)
smṛtyaṅgulaṃ tu vistāraṃ vistārārthena (-rārdhena) vardhayet | oṣṭhamekāṅgulaṃ prokta svarṇatārādibhirbhavet ||
tadardhaṃ madhyamaṃ jñeyaṃ tadardhaṃ kanyasaṃ bhavet |
kāmike (-)
sauvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmramathavā kadalīdvayam | śuddhakāṃsena (-kāṃsyena) vā kuryāt pātramādāya buddhimān ||
(71B) sūkṣme (-)
gomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā devagre maṇḍalaṃ nyaset | sthalikākṣālanaṃ kṛtvā naivedyaṃ ca prapūrayet ||
vyañjanairāmṛtai caiva lavaṇairūpadaṃśakaiḥ | phalādigulasaṃyuktaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi ca madhyame ||
ājyāvṛta samāyuktamavadhānaṃ tu vāsasi |
cintyaviśve (-)
sūpāpūpopadaṃśādyaiḥ phalairnānāvidhairapi | naivedyaṃ dāpayet tasmāt devadevasya pūrvake ||
sūkṣme (-)
gaṇḍūṣārthaṃ jalaṃ deyaṃ karasampūrṇamānataḥ | ekatripañcavāraṃ vā visṛjedastramantrataḥ ||
aṃśumati (-)
pratyeka pātre vinyāsamodanena prapūrayet | tasyorddhve vinyaset pātraṃ prokṣa(ye)ddhṛdayena tu ||
tālatrayaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dik'bandhaṃ cāvakuṇḍanam | dhenumudrāṃ pradṛśyātha pūrvapātraṃ visarjayet ||
bhakṣyaṃ bhokṣyaṃ(-jyaṃ) ca peyaṃ ca leyaṃ(-hyaṃ) śu(śo)ṣyaṃ ca pañcadhā | pariṣicyāstramantreṇa bhojanaṃ hṛdayena tu ||
madhyamānāmikā caiva aṅguṣṭhāgreṇa yojayet | (72ā) ācāryahastamuddhṛtya gaurīhaste nivedayet ||
gaurī tu śivahaste tu naivedyaṃ ca nivedayet | kapitthasya phalaṃ caiva yāvatkuñjarabhakṣaṇam ||
antassāraṃ tu jihvāyāmetat grāhyaṃ tatheśvaraḥ | tatpuṣpaṃ tu visṛjyātha hastaprakṣālanaṃ kuru ||
gaṇeśvarādiberāṇāṃ liṅgaṃ naiva tu yojayet | athavā ekapātrasthamodanena pradāpayet ||
jñānaratnāvalyām (-)
bhogāṅganāṃ pṛthak deyāmabhāvādekato bhavet |
suprabhede (-)
caturbhogaikabhāgena parivārabaliṃ dadet |
viśvasārottare (-)
elācandanacandrāṣyaṃ pānīyaṃ cātiśītalam | pāṭalyutpalapuṣpādyairvāsitaṃ ca sugandhibhiḥ ||
suprabhede (-)
pānīyaṃ cāḍhakārdhaṃ vā ardhāmathavā punaḥ |
kāmike (-)

ajāghṛtena vā lābhe śuddhatailena vā hitam | kapilāyā ghṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ madhyamaṃ tvanyajaṃ ghṛtam ||
adhamāsyādajñāsarpiśśuddhatailaṃ (adhamaṃ -) tathaiva ca | sātvikaṃ rājasaṃ caiva vāmastaṃ ca kramādbhavet ||

adhamaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ jvālajvālādīpo hyevaṃ prakīrttitam | vṛkṣabījodbhavaissnehaiḥ śivavediṃ vavarjayet ||

vyajanaṃ tu trimātraṃ syāt cāmaraṃ ca daśaṃ bhavet | chatraṃ tu pañcamātraṃ syāt munimātraṃ tu darpaṇam ||
naivedyaṃ tu tataḥ kuryāt caturviṃśatimātrakam | arghyaṃ devapriyārthaṃ syāt gandhaṃ brahmapriyaṃbhavet ||
puṣpaṃ puṣṭipradaṃ vidyāt dīpaṃ vaivat narapriyam | dīpamarkapriyaṃ jñeyamārātryaṃ tu jayapradam ||
rakṣā cāpi svarakṣārthaṃ bhūpateśca viśeṣataḥ | darpaṇaṃ jñānadaṃ caiva chatraṃ rājño balāvaham ||
cāmaraṃ śatrunāśaṃ syāt gītavādyapriyāvaham | ha snāna samṛddhiṃ syāt pānīyaṃ prāṇarakṣakam ||
tāmbūlaṃ śrīpradaṃ vidyāt homaṃ rogavināśanam | (76ā) gandhahīne payotpatti puṣpahīne tu saṅkulam ||

tasmāt sarvaprayatnena vidhivat pūjayecchivam |

arghyaṃ puṣpādikaṃ datvā japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam |
kālottare (-)

(76B) śivādabhinna sā jñeyā sarvadāraviraśmivat | mantramātā parāśaktirādyā kuṇḍalinī tu sā ||
hṛtpradeśasthitā nityaṃ ravicandrāgnisannibhā | ekā tridhātu vijñeyā iḍāpiṅgādibhedataḥ ||
suṣumnāntargatā gūḍhā jñātā gurumukhena tu | ānābherdvādaśāntāntaṃ vyāptā prāṇena vartite ||
triśūlamārgatoyādidvādaśāntaṃ tu yoginām | gamāgamaprabhedena yā diśā śaṅkare pade ||
parabhāvaṃ samāśritya parānandaṃ samaśnute | iti śaktyādikaṃ jñātvā mantrarakṣā kṣamo bhavet ||
śāktaṃ balaṃ samāśritya upāṃśurjapamārabhet | dvividhā śaktiruddiṣṭā sūryasomamayaṃ guhā ||
hṛdayāntu tripuṭyantaṃ carate pakṣivarttini | dine sūryodaye prāṇe japtavyaṃ muktikāṃkṣiṇām ||

(77ā) unmīlya netrāṇiśaratsahasram aghoramastraṃ ripunāśanārtham | tathākulantasya babhūvurakṣṇaṃ trayaṃ tato'śrūṇyapataṃśca tebhyaḥ ||
rudrākṣā viṭapai babhūvuḥ śivājñayā sarvajagaddhitāyāḥ | rudrākṣavṛkṣāstapanākṣijātāste dvādaśāssyuḥ kapilaprabhedaiḥ ||
candrākṣijā ṣoḍaśaśubhravarṇāḥ kṛṣṇā daśa syuḥ jvalanākṣijātāḥ | brahmaṃ sitaṃ kapilavarṇayuktaṃ kṣatryaṃ tu vaiśyaṃ subhagayātmakaṃ ca ||
kṛṣṇaṃ tu śūdraṃ kathayanti bījaṃ rudrākṣavṛkṣaprabhavaṃ tu jātyam | ekānanaṃ śaṅkara eva sākṣāt rudrākṣabījaṃ vinihanti hantyāt | dvivaktrabījaṃ bahugovadhaghnaṃ deveśa daivatyamalabhyamakṣam ||
āgneyamuktaṃ vadanatrayaṃ ca dhodhoṣidhaghnaṃ dadhatāṃ kṣaṇena | caturmukhaṃ yat caturānanīyaṃ narasyahatyāṃ kṣaṇato nihanti ||
kālāgnirudro nanu pañcavaktraṃ bhakṣyādutsāgaṃ mahapātakaghnam | skandaṃ hi yat ṣaḍvadanaṃ kareṇa dakṣeṇa dhāryet vijahantyaśuddhyai ||
(77B) saptānanaṃ bhogipatihvanandaḥ (-patirhyanantaḥ) steyādviśuddhiṃ vidadhāti sadyaḥ | vaināyakaṃ hyaṣṭamukhaṃ suvarṇaṃ kūṭaṃ guru strīgamanādyapaghnam ||
navānanaṃ bhairava eva devo bhuktiśca muktiṃ śivatulyaśaktim | karoti vāmena kareṇa dhāryaṃ hatyāyutānāṃ vinihanti koṭim ||
harissvayaṃ yat daśavaktrabījaṃ piśācabhūtagraha rākṣasaṃ ca | vetālasarpapratiyetisiṃha vyāghrādikāṃstāṃśca nihanti śīghram | ekādaśāsyaṃ daśa caikarudro ndhāryaṃ śikhāyāṃ vidhinā'nanvadye ||
narāśvamedhāyutavājapeyā sahasragodānasahasratulyam | yadvaktrāṇi daśadvayena kathitaṃ tat bhāskarīyaṃ smṛtam | kaṇṭhasthaṃ ravituṣṭikṛddhayamavai gomedhapuṇyassamaṃ hatya(satya)śvaśvasṛgālamūṣikakhago(-) klībāndhanārīmṛga(-) vyālākṣaḥ śukasarpamahīṣa (-) vyāghrādidoṣāpaham | yadvaktrāṇi datrayaṃ nanu letat kārtikeyaṃ smṛtaṃ sarvaṃ siddhyati bhogabhogyamatulaṃ siddhyettadaṃ pādukā | iṣṭārthaścarasārasādhanamayabhrūṇāryamātāpitṛbhrātṛstrīvadhato'p i śuddhyati dadhan nāsmāt paraṃ vidyate | (78ā) pāpiṣṭho'pi naro'kṣamekamapi yat dhatke sa śuddho bhavet |

sahasraṃ dhārayedyastu rudrākṣāṇāṃ dṛḍhavrataḥ | praṇāmanti surāssarve yathā rudraṃ tathaiva tam ||
aṣṭottaraśatairmālā rudrākṣairdhriyate yadi | kṣaṇe kṣaṇe'śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ ||

ekādaśaṃ tu rudrākṣaṃ meruhīnākṣamālika | aṅguṣṭhamūle japatassadyo muktiṣṣaḍānana ||
udrākṣa nmahābhūtyai muktidaṃ paramaṃ śubham | ekavatre trivaktrairvā caturvaktraiśca pañcabhiḥ ||
ṣaḍvaktraiścāpi kartavyaṃ tasmānmiśraistu varjayet | rudrākṣasya mukhaṃ brahma tannālaṃ viṣṇurucyate ||
(78B) rekhāyāmīśvaraṃ proktamityete adhidevata | mukhe mukhaṃ prakartavyaṃ mūlaṃ mūlena yojayet ||
dhātrīphalamāpra(---) ntu sāvitrī brahmākhyaṃ vā'tha granthinam | granthyūrdhvekaṃ tu mervākhyaṃ kartavyaṃ ta na(nna)laṅghayet ||
kṣālayet sadyamantreṇa vāmadevena gharṣayet | dhūpayet bahurūpeṇa lepayet puruṣeṇa ca ||
mantrayet pañcamenaiva pratyekaṃ tu śataṃ śatam | meruṃ ca pañcamenaiva tathāghoreṇa mantrayet ||
meruṃ ca pañcabhiḥ pūjya śivavacca yathā kramam | kaniṣṭhā'nāmikāmadhye puṣpaṃ saṅgrāhya buddhimān ||
pracchinnapaṭamācchādya mūlamantramanusmaran | vāmahaste tu kusumaṃ japet dakṣiṇapāṇinā ||
mānase vāṃśu(pāṃ-) bhabhāṣyāṇāṃ prathamaṃ cottamottamam | upāṃśumadhyamaṃ proktamadhamaṃ bhāṣyameva hi ||
tasmāt bhāṣya samutsṛjya mānasopāṃśunā japet |
(79ā) bhīmasaṃhitāyām (-)
upāṃśuyajane proktaṃ vācikaṃ homakarmaṇi | mānasaṃ tu japenmantramiti mantramudāhṛtam ||

sahasraṃ bahurūpasya japtavyaṃ tena śuddhyati | pramādāt patitaṃ bhūmau japtavyaṃ tu śatañcadham ||
patite ca tathā'nyatra prāyaścittaṃ na ceṣyate | tathā mantraṃ cākṣasūtraṃ gurorapi na darśayet ||

japamālā ca nakṣatre nāyakaṃ tu śśiśurbhavet | granthiśaktisamopetā tantu brahmādidaivataḥ ||
pañcaviṃśatimokṣārthaṃ saptaviṃśatipauṣṭikam | aṣṭāviṃśatikāmyārthaṃ pañcadaśyābhicārakam ||
maṇibandhe svayaṃ brahmā aṅguṣṭhena śatakratu | tarjanyāmīśvaro jñeyo madhyamāṅgulike śivaḥ ||
anāmikāyāmanaṅgaṃ ca kaniṣṭhe bhāskarasya tu | yakṣakinnaragandharvasarvadevadale sthitaḥ ||
evaṃ niścitya pūrve tu paścāt pañcākṣaraṃ japet | aṅguṣṭhaṃ tarjanī caiva aihikāmuṣṇikāpahet ||
aṅguṣṭhā madhyamā caiva sarvavaśye tu vai japet | aṅguṣṭhānāmikā caiva ākarṣādīni vai bhavet ||
kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhayogena vidveṣoccāṭamāraṇam | aṅguṣṭhānāmikā caiva nityamevaṃ japedbudhaḥ ||
aṣṭasūtraṃ vinā vatsā japaṃ sarvaṃ ca varjayet | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena rudrākṣajapamārabhet ||
(80ā) meruṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya japaṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ | vaśyākarṣaṇakarmāṇi śāntike pauṣṭike'pi ca ||
rudrākṣamālayā japtvā sadya eva ca siddhyati | paścime karṣaṇañcaiva uttare śāntikaṃ bhavet ||
aindre tu pauṣṭikaṃ vidyāt āgne vidveṣaṇaṃ bhavet | yāmye tu svargakāmīnāṃ nairṛtyāṃ mohanaṃ viduḥ ||
vāruṇyāṃ śāntikaṃ kuryāt vāyavyoccāṭanaṃ bhavet | saumye tu karṣaṇaṃ caiva aiśānyāṃ maraṇaṃ dhruvam ||
raktavarṇaṃ tu vīra śrīḥ pītaṃ vai stambhanaṃ bhavet | sphaṭikābhaṃ ca muktissyāt kṛṣṇasyābhicārakam ||
aṅgulijapamekaṃ tu rekhā daśaguṇaṃ bhavet | iṣṭaraṣṭaguṇaṃ vidyāt dīpe daśaguṇaṃ bhavet ||
śaṅkhe śataguṇaṃ caiva padmarāgaṃ sahasrakam | maṇibhirdaśasāhasraṃ sphaṭikaṃ lakṣamucyate ||
padmantuṃ koṭilakṣantu sauvarṇaṃ daśakoṭikam | kuśagranthikoṭi saṃyuktaṃ rudrākṣañcāvanantakam ||
gṛheṣvekaphalaṃ vidyāt gosthāne ca phalaṃ daśa | (80B) nadītīre śataṃ vidyāt tīrthe japasahasrakam ||
samudratīre koṭissyāt daśakoṭi śivālaye | siddhisthāneṣvanantaṃ syāt sthānametat varānane ||
japena pāpaṃ kṣapayedaśeṣaṃ yatnāt paraṃ janmaparamparāsu | japena rogaṃ jayate'tha(pa)mṛtyuḥ (m) japena siddhiṃ labhate ca muktiḥ (m) ||
mūlasyāṣṭaśataṃ japtvā na (*?) (dū?)pañca vilambitam |
cintyaviśve (-)
hṛdādimantritaṃ varma veṣṭitaṃ khaḍgarakṣitam | kuśapuṣpākṣatopetaṃ mudrayo bhavaka saṃjñayā ||
guhyādiguhyagoptratvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam | siddhirbhavatu me yena tvatprasādāt tvayi sthite ||
yatkiñcitkaṃ (karma) mahādeva sadā sukṛtaduṣkṛtam | taje śivapadasthasya bhrabhukṣubhavaśaṅkaraḥ ||
śivo dātā śivo bhoktā śivassarvamidaṃ jagat | śivo yajati (yachati)sarvatra yaśśivasso'hameva tu ||
iti ślokamapatnotu dakṣahastena śambhuve | mūlāṇunārghyatoyena varahaste nivedayet ||

tasmai paramadevāya parāya paramātmane | mahadbhyaścāpi mahate mahāmāyādimāyine ||

śuddhadeśo'rhasikatairanārdrairhastavistṛtam | aṅgulatrayamānocce samaṃ nimnonnataṃ na ca ||

kālottare (-)
vidadhyādastramantreṇa varmaṇā'bhyukṣaṇaṃ matam | khaḍgeṇa vā tamudghāraṃ pūraṇaṃ samatāmapi |
(82B) kurvīta varmaṇātve kaṃ kuṭṭanaṃ tu śarāṇunā | sammārjanaṃ samālepaṃ kalārūpaṃ prakalpanam ||
trisūtraparidhānaṃ ca varmaṇā'bhyarcanaṃ hṛdam | tisraḥ pūrvānanā kāryā rekhaikā cottarānanā ||
vajrīkaraṇamastreṇa vajrākāraṃ kuśaistribhiḥ | hṛdā catuṣpathaṃ kāryaṃ somendreśakuśadvayāt ||
akṣapāṭāya kuṇḍeṣṭau kavacen kuśān nyaset | vinyasya viṣṭaraṃ madhye divyaṃ sihmāsanaṃ smaret ||
tanmadhye tu ca saṃsthāpya vāgīśvarīṃ viśeṣataḥ |
mṛgendre (-)
devīmāvāhayedvidvān vidhivat viśvamātaram | śyāmāṃ ṛtumatīṃ dhyātvā satvāsomālyabhūṣaṇām ||
prasannavadanāṃ padmapatrābhanayanatrayām | vāgīśvaraṃ tu raktābhaṃ triṇetraṃ ca caturbhujam ||
abhayavaradopetaṃ pāśaśūladharānvitam | atasaṃ puṣpasaṅkāśaṃ tatradevaṃ sa (---) kṣaṇam ||

kālottare (-)

kāmike (-)
vahniṃ sadāśrayānītaṃ śuddhapātropari sthitam | (83ā) kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajya vīkṣaṇādi viśodhitam ||
audāryaṃ vaindavaṃ bhautamekīkṛtyānalatrayam | vinyasāvahnicaitanyaṃ vahnibījena deśikaḥ ||
saṃhitāmantritaṃ vahniṃ dhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtam | rakṣitaṃ hetimantreṇa kavacenāvakuṇṭhitam ||
sarvajñānottare (-)
pūjitaṃ triḥparibhrāmya kuṇḍasyordhve pradakṣiṇam | śivabījamiti dhyātvā vāgīśīgarbhagolake ||
vāgīśvareṇa devena kṣipyamāṇaṃ vibhāvayet | bhūmiṣṭhajānuko mantrī hṛdātmā sammukhaṃ kṣipet ||
tato'ntasthita bījasya nābhideśasamūhanam | saṃpratiṃ paridhānaṃ ca śaucamācamanaṃ hṛdā ||
garbhāgneḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tadrakṣārthaṃ śarāṇunā | badhnīyāddarbhajaṃ devyāḥ kaṅkaṇaṃ pāṇipallave ||
garbhādhānāya saṃpūjya sadyojātena pāvakam | tilairhṛdayamantreṇa juhuyādāhutitrayam ||
puṃsuvanāya vāmena tṛtīye māsi pūjayet | āhutitritayaṃ dadyāt śirasāmbukaṇānvitam ||

vahniṃ sandhukṣya darbhādyaissnānaṃ garbhamalāpaham | svarṇa(-rṇena(,) (-)sya) bandhanaṃ devyā kṛtaṃ dhyātvā hṛdārcayet ||
astreṇottarapūrvāgrā mekhalāsubahiḥ kuśān | āstīrya sthāpayetteṣu hṛdā paridhiviṣṭharān ||
kuśākāśā uśīraṃ ca dūrvā veṇuyavastathā | viśvāmitraṃ ca mauñjīca aṣṭadarbhāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||
kuśaṃ sadeśajā snigdhā nātiparvā na cāyatā | śukacchāyā sāgramūlā saptaparṇā na saptajā ||
pathijātāśthitāsthāne smaśāne'pi tritarpaṇe | staraṇāsanapiṇḍeṣu na grāhyāḥ saptadeśajā ||
agrasthūlaṃ bhavennārī mūlasthūlaṃ napuṃsakam | mūlamagrasamaṃ caiva puṃdarbheti prakīrtitaḥ ||
jñānaratnāvalyām (-)
śrīliṅgāmṛdavaśyāmā yāgakarmasuśobhanāḥ | pulliṅgā harimā īṣaṭśyāmadarbha na puṃsakaḥ ||
raudrakarmasu te yojya garhitā saumyakarmaṇi | (84ā) kuśamūle bhavedbrahmā kuśamadhye tu keśavaḥ ||
kuśāgre śaṅkaraścaiva kuśānāmadhidevatāḥ |
tattvatithigraha saṅgrahadarbhairaṣṭadaśāṅgulakūrca(-) kramātaṃ magrayugāṅgulagranthitadarthamuttama(-) madhyamakanyasasukūrcam |
ūrdhvakūrcaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ ca adhaḥkūrcantuśāntikam | antaḥ kūrcaṃ prakartavyamabhicārārthameva ca ||
kūrcamūle tu savitā kūrcamadhye tu vaiṣṇavī | kūrcāgre sarvatīrthāśca ityetā adhidevatāḥ ||
navapañca trisaṃyuktamagraṃ tu caturaṅgulam | granthirekāṅgulaṃ proktaṃ valayaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ bhavet ||
dvidarbhairvāpi kartavyaṃ taptacāmīkareṇavā | pradakṣiṇa padagranthiṃ nāmikāyā niyojayet ||
mūle tu pārvatī caiva granthau caiva sarasvatī | agre tu sarvatīrthāni pavitrasyādhidevatāḥ ||
sapavitrakareṇaiva kuryāsādarcanakriyām | apavitrakareṇaiva na kuryādarcana kriyām ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena pavitraṃ dhārayet sudhīḥ |
śyāmaiḥ darbhadalaiḥ svaramaguṇitaiḥ bāhupramāṇākṛtā (-) (84B) veṇvā vā'tha suva(?)rtatāssamaśikhā sadganthayo viṣṭharāḥ | tammānā ṛjavaḥ palāśatarujā śyāmāḥ paridhyāhnacā (ḥ ) idhvā (dhmāḥ) ṣoḍaśakāṅgulāsama(mi?)dapi pra(prā)deśamātrāpraṇāḥ ||

indrādīśānaparyantaṃ viṣṭarastānanukramāt | agnerabhimukho bhūtvā nnijadikṣu hṛdārcayet ||
nivāryavighnasaṅghātaṃ bālakaṃ bālayiṣyathā | śaivāgniḥ kathyate vipra śṛṇu tasmin samāhitaḥ ||
pañcavaktrasamāyuktaṃ saptajihvāvirājitam | daśahastaṃ triṇetraṃ ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ||
raktavarṇaparīdhānaṃ paṅkajopari saṃsthitam | baddhapadmāsanāsīnāṃ daśāyudhasamanvitam ||
kanakā bā(ba)hurūpā ca atiraktā tataḥ param | suprabhācaiva kṛṣṇā ca raktā cānyā hiraṇmayī ||
ūrdhvavaktre sthitā tisraśśeṣāḥ pūrvāditaḥ kramāt |

kālottare (-)

uttamaṃ tvitivikhyātaṃ madhyamaṃ ca tataśśṛṇu | samidājyacaruṃ caiva sarṣapaṃ madhyamaṃ viduḥ ||

yavaiśca brīhibhirvāpi gulgulena ghṛtena vā | ityahomaḥ prakartavyo yathāvittānusārataḥ ||
padmasthaṃ pañcavaktraṃ daśabhujasahitaṃ raktavarṇaṃ triṇetraṃ
śūlaṃ vajraṃ ca khaḍgaṃ triśikhasṛṇigadā ṭaṅkapāśābjacakram |
bibhrāṇaṃ savyadakṣekarasarasiruhe saptajihvāsadīptaṃ(-) dhyāyet svāhāsametaṃ pracuranijaruciṃ kuṇḍamadhye śivāgnim ||
gāruhāhavanīyapadakṣiṇe bālayā vanavṛddhasvarūpakāḥ |
sthāpakādiśikhotsavanityakaṃ pūjakādi śivāgnisvarūpakam ||
vṛddharūpaṃ prathiṣṭhāgniryutsavāgnistu yauvanam | (86ā) dīkṣāgniṃ palāśaṃ ca nandyāvartaṃ ca mallikaḥ |
karavīrabakaṃ caiva nīlotpalamathāṣṭakam | āsane prathamaṃ puṣpaṃ dātavyaṃ śuddhacetasā ||
mūrtidānaṃ hṛdā kāryaṃ puṣpeṇaiva pareṇa tu | pañcapuṣpapradānena pañcāṅgāni prapūjayet ||
śivaṃ tathā'ṣṭamenaiva netrahīnāṣṭapuṣpika | etāni cāṣṭapuṣpāṇi sarvasādhāraṇāni tu ||
prātarmadhyāhnasāyāhne tathācāstimiteravau | pūjayetparayā bhaktyā'bhyaṣṭapuṣpavidhānataḥ ||
daridrāṇāmanāthānāṃ bālastrī bāliśeṣu ca | gobhīnāṃ vyādhijuṣṭānāṃ tathā dhyānārpitātmanām |
śivaśāstrānuraktānāṃ nāsīnāsiddhihitātmanām | anuraktaviraktānāṃ kathitācāṣṭapuṣpikā ||
āvāhanārghyapūjāsu snāne dhūpavilepane | nivedya ca visarge ca puṣpamaṣṭau suyojayet ||
svāmin kṣudreṇa dāsena malīmasadhiyā mayā | kadarthito'si yadbhaktileśāt priyadakṣamaracat ||
tataḥ pūrvavadabhyarcya stutvā stotraiḥ praṇamya ca | arghyaṃ parāṅmukhaṃ datvā kṣamasvetyabhidhāya ca ||
(86B) nārā ca mudrayā'streṇa phaḍanteṇānu sañcayam | saṃhṛtyadīpyayā liṅge mūrtimantreṇa yojayet ||
sthaṇḍile tvarcite deva mantrasaṅghātamātmani |
aṃśumati (-)
gaṇeśvarādiberāṇāṃ vastreṇaiva tu veṣṭayet | keṭakasyaikabhāge tu vinyasedastramantrataḥ ||
śivamantramanusmṛtya liṅgaṃ saṅgṛhya deśikaḥ | citravastreṇa saṃveṣṭayā pheṭake madhyame nyaset ||
apidhānaṃ tu saṃyojya bhīmarudraṃ smarettataḥ | niyojya vidhivattena caṇḍapūjāṃ samā bhavet ||

nirmālya bhojanaṃ tubhyaṃ pradataṃ(-ttaṃ) tu śivājñayā | sarvametat kriyākāṇḍaṃ mayā caṇḍa tavājñayā ||
nyūnādhikaṃ kṛtaṃ mohāt paripūrṇaṃ tadastu me |
iti vijñāpya caṇḍeśamarcayitvā yathāvidhi | pūrakānvitamūlena mantrānātmani yojayet ||
pratyahaṃ pūjayedyastu
(itaḥ paraṃ vidyamānapuṭasthaviṣayasya anena sambandho na bhavediti kṛtvā 161 puṭe tat likhyate)
(----) hoturvijānīyāt karmasiddhirabhīpsitā | jīmūtavallarīśaṅkhamṛdaṅgadhvanirūpakaḥ ||
tasyognisiddhaye hoturato'nyaśca viparyayaḥ | chatrākāro bhṛguśreṣṭho dhvajacāmarasannibhaḥ ||
vṛṣakuñjarayānena tulye'gni puṣṭidassadā | pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā namaskṛtvāṃ ca bhaktitaḥ ||
visarjayettamo devaṃ punaḥ pūjāṃ vidhānataḥ | tato vahniṃ samabhyarcya phaṭantāstreṇa śambarām ||
bhāsvarān paridhisthāṃ ca pūrakeṇa hṛdāṇunā | śraddhayā paramātmī ve sthāpayet tān hṛdambuje ||
sūkṣme (-)
viṣṭarāṇi samādāya granthiṃ muktvā visarjayet | paristaraṇamānīya ājyenaiva tu secayet ||
ekadarbhaṃ samādāya śeṣamagrādikaṃ dahet | tadekamagnau nikṣipya tadbhasma tilakaṃ kuru ||
tadbhasma tu lalāṭe tu netramantreṇa dhārayet | tadbhasmadhāraṇaṃ puṃsāmāyuśśrīkīrtivardhanam ||
vijayaṃ roganāśārthaṃ sarvakāma phalapradam | sarvapākāgramādāya kṛtvā maṇḍalakadvayam ||
antarbahirvaktiṃ dadyādāgneyyā kuṇḍasannidhau | tataḥ śivāntikaṃ gatvāṃ pūjāhomādikarmakam ||
gṛhāṇa bhagavan puṇyaphalamityabhidhāya ca | homasaṃkhyāni mantrāṇi japtvā daśaguṇaṃ tathā ||
tajjapṃ parahaste tu tatpuṣpaṃ tu samarpayet | yatkṛtaṃ yatkariṣyāmi tatsarvaṃ sukṛtaṃ tu vā ||
viśvagoptā tvamevātra nānyo nātho hi me śiva |
