oṃ padmahastāya aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | tejorāśine tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | mārtāṇḍāya madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | ādityāya anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | sūryāya kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ | sahasrakiraṇāya karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | padmahastāya hṛdayāya hum | tejorāśine śirase svāhā | mārtāṇḍāya śikhāyai vauṣaṭ | ādityāya kavacāya hum | sūryāya netratrayāyai vauṣaṭ | sahasrakiraṇāya astrāya phaṭ | bhūrbhuvassuvaromiti digbandhaḥ ||
dhyānam (-)
padmārūḍhaṃ radhende vasudalasahite vṛttaṣaṭkoṇamadhye bhāsvantaṃ bhāskaraṃ taṃ dadhatamadagaja(-) śaṅkhapadmāni devam | (134B) vedākāraṃ trimūrtiṃ vividhaguṇamayaṃ viśvarūpaṃ purāṇam oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ kararūpaṃ suratamaniśaṃ bhāvayeddhyasya rāje ||
jayākusumasaṅkāśaṃ kāśyapeyaṃ mahadvitim | dātāraṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ praṇatosti divākaram ||
adhunā saṃpravakṣyāmi kavacaṃ sarvakāmadam | idaṃ tu kavacaṃ buddhyā vicaret vigatajvarā ||
ghrīṇipāttu śiro nitya lalāṭaṃ pātu bhāskara | ādityo me śiro pātu śrotre pātu divākarā ||
ghrāṇaṃ pātu sadā bhānurmukha kkeyaraṃ ravi | jihvāṃ pātu jagannetrakarṇau pātu sulocanā ||
skandhau divyāyudhaḥ pātu bhujau pātu vibhākara | karāyuṣṇakaraḥ pātu hṛdayaṃ pātu bhānumān |
kukṣipātu sa saptāśvo nābhiṃ pātu nabhomaṇiḥ | ḍādaśātmā kaṭiṃ pātu satvinī savitā tathā ||
(135ā) ūru pātu suraśreṣṭho sūryo jānuśirastathā | jānunī pātu mārtaṇḍo gulphau pātu vibhāvasoḥ ||
padau bhānussadā pātu mi (----) ścai vakhilaṃ vapuḥ | idamekaṃ kṛtaṃ gauryā vicintyākhilakāmadam ||
satataṃ prātarutthāya paṭhedrogādvimucyate ||
iti sūryakavacaṃ sampūrṇam ||
sūryaṃ sundaralokanādhamamṛtaṃ vedāntasāraṃ jñānaṃ brahmamayaṃ sureśamamalaṃ lokaikacittasvayam | indrādityanarādhipaṃ suraguruṃ trailokyacūḍāmaṇiṃ brahmāviṣṇuśivasvarūpahṛdayaṃ vande sadā bhāskaram ||
udayaṃ brahmasvarūpāyā madhyāhnaṃ tu maheśvarim | hastamānaṃ svayaṃ viṣṇuṃ trimūrtiṃ tu divākaram ||
kālātmā sarvabhūtātmā vedātmā viśvatomukham | janmamṛtyu jarāvyādhisaṃsārabhayanāśanam ||
padmahastaṃ paraṃ jyotiḥ pareśāya namonamaḥ | bhāskaro jyotimārtāṇḍā jyotirāditya te namaḥ ||
(135B) aṇḍayoni mahāsākṣi ādityāya namo namaḥ | kamalākarapuṣpī cā kāmarūpī namo namaḥ ||
sakaleśāya sūryāya sāraṅgāya namo namaḥ | amokhā vidyutaścaivā aṣṭamūrti namo namaḥ ||
paramūrti parameṣṭi pāpaṃ nāśi namonamaḥ | itihāsapurāṇāya sarvaśāstrī namo namaḥ ||
setuṃ phañca mahābāho triyambakāya namo namaḥ | ravimaṇḍalamadhyastaṃ sūryarūpi namo namaḥ ||
sākaro sukhamākhyāta tārakāya namo namaḥ | nirmalādityaśāntāya niṣkalāya namo namaḥ ||
sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ nityaṃ nityānanda namo namaḥ | surasaundaranāthāya sarvarūpin namo namaḥ |
rakṣārthaṃ bhayanāśāya astraśastranivāraṇam | saubhāgyaṃ dhanalābhārtha māyurvardhanamuttamam ||
caṇḍamārutasarvābhyāṃ dākṣiṇyāṃ bhūmivardhanam | apasmāraṃ kṣayaṃ kuṣṭaṃ tadvoṣaṃ tadvināśanam ||
ṣāṇmāsāt sarvakāryārthaṃ saṃvatsaramupāsakam | (136ā) sarvakāryeṣu siddhyanti sūryaloke mahīyate ||
śrīsūryaloke mahīyata iti ||
jayatu jayatu sūryaṃ saptalokaikadīpaṃ kiraṇa sahita pādaṃ kleśaduḥkhasyamokṣam | aruṇagaganagamyamādirādityamūrtiṃ paramaparamadūraṃ bhāskaraṃ taṃ namāmi ||
namassavitre jagadekacakṣuṣe jagatprasūtisthitināśahetave | trayīmayāya triguṇātmadhāriṇe viriñcinārāyaṇaśaṅkarātmane ||
sūryagāyatrī (-)
oṃ bhāskarāya vidmahe mahādyutikarāya dhīmahi | tanno ādityaḥ pracodayāt ||
oṃ tatsaviturvareṇiyam bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
oṃ hrīṃ ghrīṇi sūrya ādityom | śrīṃ sohamarkamahajyotirasomahom ||
oṃ hrīṃ ghrīṇi sūrya ādityom śrīṃ sohararka jyotirahaṃ śivaḥ |
ātmajyotirahaṃ śukla sarvajyotiraso mahom | oṃ hrīṃ ghrīṇi sūrya ādityoṃ śrīm ||
ādityaṃ bhāskaraṃ bhānuṃ ravisūryadivākaraṣaḍaitāni sma nityaṃ cakṣurdivyastapomayam ||
śrīgurubhyo namaḥ ||
gaṇapati kavacam ||
(136B) oṃ asya śrī gaṇapati mahāmantrasya parabrahma ṛṣiḥ | anuṣṭup chandaḥ | śrī mahāgaṇapatirdevatā | gaṃ bījam | ṇaṃ śaktiḥ | paṃ kīlakam | mahāgaṇapati prasādasiddhyarthe sarvābhīṣṭasiddhyarthe bhogamokṣārthe mahāgaṇapatiprītyarthe jape viniyogaḥ |
oṃ gajānanāya aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ |
oṃ gaṃ lambodarāya tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ haṃ śūrpakarṇāya madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ |
oṃ raṃ mūṣikavāhanāya anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ gaṇādhīśvarāya kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ gaum vighnarājāya karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ gajānanāya hṛdayāya hum | oṃ gaṃ laṃbodarāya śirase svāhā | oṃ haṃ śūrpakarṇāya śikhāyai vauṣaṭ | oṃ raṃ mūṣikavāhanāya kavacāya hum ||
oṃ śrīṃ gaṇādhīśvarāya netratrayāya vauṣaṭ | oṃ gauṃ vighnarājāya astrāya bhaṭ | bhūrbhuvassvaromiti dikabandhaḥ ||
dhyānam (-)
(137ā) viśveśaṃ viśvavandyaṃ vimalayaśasaṃ sarvadakṣāsu dakṣaṃ sākṣāt sarvāpadāsu prakaṭita sumatiṃ pārvatīprāṇasūnum | pāyāt sarvān susendrān suramunigaṇān sādhitaṃ siddhakeyaṃ kāruṇyenāntarāyāmapahara niyataṃ vighnarājaṃ namāmi ||
khantaṃ sāntaṃ samāyuktaṃ yantaṃ māyāsamanvitam | trayodaśāhasaṃyuktaṃ ṣaṭkasvarasamanvitam ||
mūlamantramidaṃ proktaṃ vighneśasya prajāpate | oṃ gaṃ haṃ raṃ śrīṃ gauṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ ||
brahmavāca (-)
nandikeśvara sarvajña bhaktānugrahakāraka | bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ paraḥ |
kavacaṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvakāmyārthasādhakam | ādhivyādhiharaṃ śrāvyaṃ kamalāvāsakāraṇam ||
vāksiddhilabhate martyā kāmyakāraṇabhūtitam | vaktumarhasi me devaṃ nandikeśasurottamaḥ ||
nandikeśvarauvāca (-)
śrūṇu brahman pravakṣyāmi guhyāt guhyatamaṃ param | (137B) sarvalokahitārthāya kāritaṃ candramaulinam ||
bhūtapretapiśācādi brahmarākṣasanāśanam | kṣayābhasmārakuṣṭhādi cāturthyakanivāraṇam ||
mahārogapraśamanaṃ rājakrodhanivāraṇam | vātapittodbhavān rogān anyāṃścaiva sadāruṇān ||
ityevamādisarveṣu bhayakālamupāsthite | pūrvaṃ vighneśakavacaṃ japitvā stotramācaret ||
tasmāt śṛṇuṣva bhagavān caturmukhamahāyaśaḥ | śucirbhūtvā trirācamya pīyatassarvadā japet ||
viśeṣeṇa japedvidvān muhūrte brahmakālake |
oṃ macībhṛṅgasabilvabadarīdurdhūrakaṃcāsurairapāmārgabṛhatīcamī ca karavīraśmāntaraskārjunaṃ kāntā ḍāḍimī devadāru maruva sindhūrapatraṃ tathā jātī gaṇḍalī patrikāsuvidhivat vighneśapūjākramam ||
śubhamastu ||
śrīvighneśvarakavacam ||
oṃ asya śrī vighneśvarakavacastotramahāmantrasya ādipuruṣottama ṛṣiḥ | anuṣṭup chandaḥ | śrīvighneśvaro devatā | viṃ bījam | ghnaṃ śaktiḥ | śaṃ kīlakam | mama (138ā) samastapāpakṣayārthe dharmārthakāmyamokṣacaturvidhaphalapuruṣārthasiddhyarthe sarvābhīṣṭasiddhyarthe sakaladuritanivāraṇārthe iṣṭakāmyārthasiddhyarthe vighneśvaraprītyarthe jape viniyogaḥ ||
oṃ gajānanāya aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ gaṃ lambodarāya tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ haṃ śūrpakarṇāya madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ raṃ mūṣikavāhanāya anāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ śrīṃ gaṇādhīśvarāya kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ | oṃ gaum vighnarājāya karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ |
oṃ gajānanāya hṛdayāya hum | oṃ lambodarāya śirase svāhā | oṃ gaṃ śūrpakarṇāya śikhāyai vauṣaṭ | oṃ raṃ mūṣikavāhanāya kavacāya hum | oṃ śrīm gaṇādhīśvarāya netratrayāyai vauṣaṭ | oṃ vighnarājāya astrāya bhaṭ | bhurbhuvassuvaromiti dik(g)bandhaḥ |
dhyānam (-)
vighneśaṃ viśvavandyaṃ vimala (---) śasaṃ sarvadakṣaṃ sudakṣaṃ sākṣāt sarvāpadāsu prakaṭitasumatiṃ pārvatīprāṇa sūnum | pāyāt sarvān susendrān sasuramuni gaṇān sādhitaḥ siddhakeyaṃ kāruṇyenāntarāyāmapaharaniyataṃ vighnarājaṃ namāmi ||
vighneśaṃ pūrvataḥ pātu gaṇādhyakṣaṃstu dakṣiṇe | paścime gajavassa uttare vighnanāśanaḥ ||
āgneyāṃ ci(vi)trabhaktastu nairṛtyāṃ skandapūrvajaḥ | vāyavyāmākhuvāhassyāt īśānye devapūjitaḥ ||
ūrdhvataḥ pātu sumukho adhodiśi gajānanaḥ | evaṃ diśi diśo rakṣet vikaṭaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ ||
śikhāyāṃ kapilaḥ pātu mūrdhni rākāśarūpadhṛk | kirīṭiḥ pātu naḥ phālaṃ bhūmadhye yaśaso'dhitam ||
cakṣurmadhye triṇayanaṃ śravaṇe gajakarṇakaḥ | kapolayo madanabhiḥ karṇamūle madotkaṭaḥ ||
sudantau dantamadhye tu chando vāci(dvi) padāśca yaḥ | cibuke nāsike caiva pātu māṃ karodayaḥ ||
ūrdhvaroṣṭre jagadvāpi adharoṣṭre mṛtaḥ pradaḥ | hanū pātu sudaṃṣṭro me manaḥ praśvādakārakaḥ ||
praṇāpānatathā vyāna udānaṃ ca samānakam | yaśaḥ kīrtiñca lakṣmīṃ ca pātu māṃ pārvatīsutaḥ ||
hṛdayaṃ tu paraṃ brahma svarūpo jagatīpatiḥ | udaraṃ tutilaḥ pātu nābhau pādaṃ tu (---) gakaḥ ||
meḍhraṃ pātu mahāyogi tadvāri sarvarakṣasām | jitendriḥ pātu cāṇḍau ca guhyaṃ pātu guhāgrajaḥ ||
śuklaṃ pāda tu śukra stvau ūrū pātu sukhapradā | jaṅghadeśe hrasvajaṃghe jānumadhye jagadguruḥ ||
gulphau rakṣākaraṃ pātu pādayo nirtanaḥ priyaḥ | sarvāṅgāni skanda vā(pā)tu devārimardanaḥ ||
dhanadhānyapaśūṃścaiva gṛhakṣetranirantaraḥ | pātu viśvātmako devaḥ varado bhaktavatsalaḥ ||
rakṣāhīnaṃ tu yatsthānaṃ varjitaṃ kavacena tu | tatsarvaṃ rakṣito devo mārgavāsī jitendriyaḥ ||
(139B) aṭavyāṃ parvatāgreṣu mārgamānāvamānike | jalasthalagato vāpi pātumāyāpahārikā |
ya yidaṃ kavacaṃ divyaṃ pavitraṃ pavanāśanam | āpatkāle bhavenmṛtyu yadā bhayanivāraṇam ||
kukṣirogapraśamanaṃ lūtasphoṭanivāraṇam | bālagrahādirogāṇāṃ śamanaṃ sarvakālikam ||
yaḥ paṭhe dhārayettasya karasthāt sarvasiddhayaḥ | yatra yatra gato vāpi tatra tatrārthasiddhayaḥ ||
yaśśṛṇoti japati dvijottamau yakṣarakṣasurasiddhapūjitaḥ | putrapautrasakalatrameyayā kāmabhogamakhalīsubhañjatī ||
yaṃ brahmacāriṇamacintyamanekarūpaṃ dhyāyet jagattrayahiteritamāpadaghnam | sarvāṃ ca siddhiṃ labhate manuṣyo vighneśaṃsāyujyamupetyasaṃśayaḥ ||
iti brahmāṇḍapurāṇe brahmanandikeśvarasaṃvāde vighneśvarakavacaṃ sampūrṇam ||
śrīgaṇādhīśvarāya namaḥ ||
(140ā) kṛttikādīpaprāyaścittam ||
prāyaścittavidhiṃ vakṣye dīpasyaiva ṣaḍānanaḥ | māle tu kṛttikākhye'smin parvayukte kṛte sati ||
pañcāśat snapanaṃ kṛtvā sahasradekṣiṇaṃ jepet | kṛttīkāsaṃyutā śreṣṭhā madhyamā bharaṇī yutā ||
adhamā rohiṇī yuktā kṛttikastrividhāsmṛtāḥ | kramukhaṃ nālikeraṃ ca cambakaṃ candanaṃ tathā ||
veṇuṃ vācyārjunaṃ vāpi tintriṇī śiśapaṃ tathā ||
mayūkhaṃ vakulaṃ vāpi stālastambhamathāpi vā | avakraṃ nighṛṇaṃ caivā kṛmikoṭaravarjitam ||
savakraṃścalahīnaṃ syāt savraṇaṃ śatruvardhanam | kṛmikoṭaravakrāṇi sadyaśśāntiṃ samācaret ||
dīpadaṇḍamidaṃ proktaṃ sāradraya mathāpi vā | taddaṇḍaṃ vasudhā kṛtvā ekāṃśaṃ bhūmniveśanam ||
yathā balaṃ yathā puṣṭiṃ tathā vṛkṣaṃ samācaret | śatapañcāśadvaṣṭāni vṛkṣāyubhya prakīrtitam ||
(140B) bālavṛddhayuvānāṃ ca yuvānaṃ śreyasī matā | balā ca grāmanāśaṃ syāt vṛddhāyuṣya kṣayaṃ bhavet ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena ma(u)ttaṃ vṛkṣeṇa kārayet | tānyavṛkṣeḥ kuryāt śāntisūktamathācaret ||
nālikerasupatraṃ vā tālapatramathāpi vā | kharjūra kramukhaṃ vāpi kadalīdalanaṃ ritāḥ ||
athavā ketakī patraṃ sambhave gṛhyadeśikaḥ | dīpadaṇḍeṣu badhvā yā tattat śuṣkeṇa saṅgrahet ||
tatpatraṃ śuṣkahīnaṃ cet akṣirogaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | citravastreṇa nāveṣṭya taraṅgaṇavibhūṣitam ||
vastrahīne mahākṣobhaṃ patrahīne balakṣayam | aghoreṇa japitvā tu tattat hīne sahasrakam ||
vitānahīnaṃ balaṃ śānti sadyamantraṃ samācaret | kṛttikādīparātrau tu bījānāpaṃ samārabhet ||
agnyādhānādikaṃ sarvamagnikāryoktamācaret | navapātrāṇi saṅgrāhyā kapilājyena pūrayet ||
(141ā) pātraṃ prati viśeṣeṇa ṣkalaṃ pratikīrtitam | karpūravartitaṃ śreṣṭha tat hīne tu balakṣayam ||
tadagne ropayeddhīmān īśādyādi mukheṣu ca | tadante kautukaṃ baddhnā beraṃ śūlena daṇḍakam ||
aṅkurarpaṇahīne tu savyānāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavet | daśākṣaraṃ śataṃ japtvā droṇaṃ kṣīrābhiṣecanam ||
navāṃ ghṛtavihīne tu mūlenaiva śataṃ hunet | vyomavyāpi śataṃ japtvā karpūreṇaṃ vihīnake ||
pañcaviṃśañca kalaśai stāpayet parameśvaram | adhivāsanadīpāni śivāstrasahanirgataḥ ||
sarvavādyasamāyuktaṃ stotramaṅgalavācakaiḥ | daṇḍāsthānamanu prāpya puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ ||
daṇḍo'bhiṣicya saṃpūjyā rakṣābandhanayārabhet | kautukaṃ hīnamenaṃ syāt droṇakṣīrābhiṣecayet ||
tadante talapūjāṃ syāt tanmūle tu nidhāpayet | adhivāsanadīpaṃ tu pramādāttu vinaśyati ||
(141B) sadyodhivāsanaṃ kṛtvā snapanaṃ śāntihomakam | adhivāsanamityuktam |
samyak dīpamihocyate ||
sāyarakṣāvasāne tu dīpārohaṇamārabhet | ravyastamayādūrdhve tu ghaṭikārdhaṃ parityajet ||
tantradhvadīpakālaṃ tu tathārdhe dīpasaṅgrahet | akāle dīpamāropya mūlenaiva śataṃ japet ||
ṣoḍaśasnapanaṃ kuryāt śantihomaṃ samācaret | śivāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā dīpapātrāṇi sadhayet ||
vighneśaṃ tu samārabhyā puṇyāhaṃ vācayet tataḥ | īśānādi ca sadyāntaṃ pātrapañcasu pūjayet ||
puṇyāhaṃ hīnamevaṃ syāt śrīkarañca vinaśyati | snāpaye parameśānāṃ droṇakṣīrābhiṣecayet ||
pātrapūjā na kṛtaṃ mahātāpana saṃśayaḥ | mūlenaiva śataṃ japtvā snāpayet pañcagavyakaiḥ ||
pātradvayaṃ samānīyā devasyarthaṃ śivārthakam | madhye dīpaṃ samāropyā stāpayet tatra sannidhau ||
ahaṃ yadyapi deveśaṃ durbalasyolpasādhanam | bhaktyā karoti pūjānte tato na jñātumastasi ||
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ malaṅkṛtya viśeṣataḥ | umāskandeśvaraṃ devamastra devasamanvitam ||
(142ā) dīpapātrāṇi saṃyukta sarvavādyasamāyutam | nānādīpasamāyuktaṃ gaṇikābhiralaṃkṛtam ||
dīpasthānaṃ samaśṛtyā puṇyāhaṃ tatra vācayet | sadyojādidīpādintekīkṛtya supūjayet ||
viparītena saṃyojya taddīpaniṣphalaṃ bhavet | lakṣadvaya maghoraṃ syāt japtvā taddīpaśuddhayet ||
dīpikā yugamādāya taddīpo ropayet kuru | nirīkṣya devadevāya jyotiliṅgamanusmaran ||
snātvā poṣya(phaca?) śucirbhutvā samardhai paracārakaḥ | śivavījamanusmṛtya dīpaṃ saṅgṛhya pāṇiṇā ||
sa daṇḍe śīghramāropya magradīpaṃ na yojayet | indrā yama kuberasya varuṇāni diśi smṛtā ||
rājā rāṣṭrābhivṛddhatvadhanadhānyāyuvaddhinā | etamuccārya manasā dīpakāṃ patito bhuvi ||
agrādimūlaparyanta mahājyotimanusmaran | ghaṭike kāṣṭhabhāgena śreṣṭhadīpajvalottamam ||
yadi kāṣṭhaṃ(kāṣṭaṃ-)śayuktā cet adhamādhamamācaret | vijayaṃ rāṣṭravṛddhiṃ ca pūjāvṛddhibalaṃ tathā |
(142B) bhra(gra)mavṛddhisuvarṇāni rogaśokabhayaṃ tathā | dīpasyaiva phalaṃ proktaṃ umādikramamāt guhā ||
dīpānteṣu sadaṇḍe ca kuṭhareṇaiva śvedayet | tiṣuṃcet grāmanāśaṃ syāt śāntiṃ sadya samācaret ||
dīpānte bhrāmayet grāmaṃ hīne doṣaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | pañcaviṃśatyakalaśai stāpayet parameśvaram ||
yānakāle sadā samyak marjanaṃ prokṣaṇam tathā | traṇamūlādikāndatvā bhūminninnaryugāṅgulam ||
athavā maṅgulāvāpi secayet sumanoharam | secanaṃ na kṛtaṃ tenā jvaramārī pravartate ||
snāpayet devadevāya kalaśaiḥ pañcaviṃśati | ninmonnatastu jaṃvālā kaṇṭakāśuddha saṃbhavet ||
kalahe rudhiraṃ srāve mahāvāyu ḍuvṛṣṭikā | taddoṣaśamanārthāyā madhuśarkarasarpikā ||
ṣaṭgavyairabhiṣekaṃ tu pratyekaṃ dhārikīrtitāḥ | tribhāraṃ jalasaṃyukta phalameka sarocanā ||
stāpayet parameśāna mabhīṣṭaphalasiddhinam | (143ā) agre sūkaradṛṣṭaṃ cet hatvā śāntiṃ samācaret ||
akṛte sati rānejño yaṃ vāhanānāṃ kṣayaṃ bhavet | mahāmaryādividhyeṣu parito grahavās(---) cet ||
naro mṛte mahādoṣastatkāle tu supūjayet | pūjā kṛtvā tu mohena rojño doṣaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
snapanaṃ kārayeddhīmān dhyamatrayamadhyataḥ | yānakāle tu tāmbūlaṃ pūṣā rasaphalādibhiḥ ||
ninidheyarmaheśānāṃ dhūpadīpapurassaram | na dadeyastu mohena mohenākṣatotpattistu jāyate ||
śāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snapanaṃ kārayet prabho | payaṣṣoḍaśakā pūrṇā gaṇikābhiralaṅkṛtā ||
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā muktābharaṇa bhūṣitā | indrādīśānaparyantaṃ sandhyānṛttaṃ samācaret ||
sandhivṛttavihīne tu snapanaṃ kārayenna vā | yālacarmasarañjāśca gānakaṃsastu pañcadhā ||
etopanneṣu bahudhā yānakāle tu ghoṣayet | pañcaghoṣavihīneṣu sarājabaliro bhavet ||
(143B) tattaddoṣābhiśamanaṃ pañcabrahmaṃ śataṃ japet | evaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā praviśedālayaṃ prati ||
nīrāñjanavihīne ca janānāṃ duḥkhamāpnuyāt | daśākṣaraṃ śataṃ japtvā prāgvannīrāñjanaṃ bhavet ||
snapanaṃ kārayeddhīmān pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ | naivendya nityahomaṃ ca balinityotsantathā ||
śuddhanṛttaṃ tadante tu tadante pṛthukaṃ dadet | uktaṃ tat hīnamevaṃ syāt śāntiṃ sadya samācaret ||
triṃśadviśaṃ daśaṃcaivā uttamatrayamīritam | navabhāraṃ trithā kṛtvā madhyamatrayamīritam ||
ekabhāraścatudroṇaravārisyādadhamādhamaḥ | pṛthukaṃ dāpayet dvidvān śalasārasajīrakam ||
elāmarīci saṃyuktaṃ nālikeraphalaṃ tathā | apūpādaśavidhaiḥ kṛtvā devadevāya dāpayet ||
tatkāle sakalādīni pṛthukaṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak | sā nīyaṃ dāpayet sadya tāmbūlaṃ dāpayet tataḥ ||
evaṃ kṛte narendrasya vijayāyabhyadaṃ sadā | akṛte sati mohena sthānabhraṃśo na saṃśayaḥ ||
taddoṣaśamanārthāyā gavyājyairabhiṣecanam | śatapañcāśatatsārdham uttameṣu suyojayet ||
triṃśadviṃśardaśaprasthā madhyamatrayameva hi | saptapañcatripūsaṃ vā adharmeva prakīrtitaḥ ||
(144ā) ghṛtābhiṣecanaṃ kuryāt pūrvoktena vidhānataḥ ||
[iti vātulākhye mahātantre kirtikā dīpaprāyaścittapaṭalaḥ] ||
gurubhyo namaḥ ||
dvādaśasnapanam | pañcaviṃśatisnapanam ||
pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ pañcagavyakuśodakam | kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ caivā koṇapārśve tu vinyaset ||
panasāmṛkalaṃ pakvai kadalīkuśapaṃ ntathā | āgneyyādiṣu koṇeṣu vinyasettu vidhānataḥ ||
māṇikka madhyame naysya haimābjena yutaṃ na vā | śātakumbhe tu vinyasya hemanīlotpalaṃ nyaset ||
śivakumbhe śivaṃ yaṣṭvā vardhānyāṃ tu manonmanim | vaikartanādikaṃ bāhye arcayet svasvanāmataḥ |
[iti dvādaśasnapanapaṭalaḥ] ||
pañcaviṃśasnapanam ||
snapanaṃ pañcaviṃśaśca vakṣyate tāṃ vṛtā mayā | prathamaṃ śodhayitvā tu dvitīyamanulepanam ||
tṛtīyaṃ sūtravinyāsaṃ caturthaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhavet | pañcamaṃ padavinyāsaṃ kūrcavinyāsa ṣaṣṭamam ||
saptamaṃ mantravinyāsaṃ devatānyāsamaṣṭamam | vidhānaṃ navamaṃ proktaṃ daśamaṃ vastravedanam ||
ekādeśaṃ gandhapuṣpaṃ dvādaśaṃ dhūpadīpakam | mudra trayodaśaṃ proktaṃ puṇyāhaṃ tu caturdaśam ||
pañcādaśaṃ ghaṭoddhāraṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ snapanaṃ bhavet | (144B) astreṇa śodhayet bhūmi vāmadevena lepayet ||
sūtranyāsamaghoreṇa sthaṇḍilaṃ puruṣeṇa tu | hṛdayena nyaset kumbhān īśānyenā na labhyate ||
mūlena vinyase dravyān vāmena vāhayet surān | śarāvān bījamukhyena vastrāṇi hṛdayena tu ||
īśānanaiva śālādīn dhūpādīn kavacena tu | dadyā mudrāmaghoreṇa vācayet pavamānakam ||
prokṣayettu viśeṣeṇa puṇyāhaṃ tu yathārhakāḥ | praṇavena ghaṭoddhāraṃ mahāvyometi mantrataḥ ||
prāksūtraṃ vasusūtraṃ syāt udaksūtraṃ tathaiva ca | madhyame navakumbhantu diśi ṣaṭkaṃ parityajet ||
āgneyyadiṣu koṇeṣu yugasaṃkhyā prakīrtitā | pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ pañcagavyaṃ kuśodakam ||
kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ caiva pṛthavāvaraṇaṃ nyaset | tilaṃ ca bilvapatraṃ ca candaṃ meghameva cā |
campakaṃ hariberaṃ ca sarṣapaṃ nāgakesaram | tatkolaṃ capalaṃ koṣṭhaṃ katrolaṃ caiva lohakam ||
lavaṅga patrakarpūraṃ vinyasettu krameṇa tu | (145ā) maheśvaraṃ mahādevīṃ kumbhatoyaistu madhyajet |
prathamāvaraṇe caiva vidyeśān parito yajet | lokapālāt dvitīye tu tṛtīye ca bhavādikān ||
[iti vātulākhye mahātantre pañcaviṃśati snapanam paṭalaḥ] ||
aṣṭācatvāri snapanam ||
snapanaṃ vakṣyate samyak aṣṭācatvāriṣaṇmukhāḥ | prāksūtraṃ dvādaśaṃ sūtraṃ syāk udaksūtraṃ tathaiva cā ||
madhyenavapataṃ grāhyām aṣṭadvāraṃ prakīrtitam | dikvidik grahasaṃkhyā ca tattatkoṇaṃ tyajedbudhaḥ ||
indrādīśānaparyanta pratyeyaṃ bāṇasaṃkhyayā | madhyame śivakumbhantu abhitoṣṭa ghaṭān nyaset ||
evameva meva krameṇaiva sthāpayet matimān guhaḥ | svarṇaṃ vā rajataṃ vāpi tāmrajā mṛṇmayastu vā ||
mṛṇmayastu dviśeṣeṇa kalaṅgarahitāśśubhāḥ | kālaṃ tu kalahaṃ vidyāt bhinnaṃ caiva kulakṣayam ||
suṣiraṃ rāṣṭranāśaṃ ca heto rājavināśanam | ścede vicchedanaṃ kuryāt līne vyādhisamudbhavam ||
nirdagdhaṃ bālanāśaṃ ca strīnāśaṃ tu purāṇake | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena doṣāṇyetānivarjayet ||
triyyaṅgulaṃ tu vistāraṃ nimnaṃ rudrāṅgulāyatam | (145B) āsyaṃ vedāṅgulaṃ jñeya kaṇṭhāyāmaṃ tathāntakam ||
oṣṭamekāṅgulaṃ jñeyamardhāṅgulaṃ tu nirgamam | galasyāṣṭarirekhā yuk pakvabimbaphalapradam ||
śivakumbhamiti proktamidamanyaṃ śṛṇuṣvatha | kalaśānāṃ svarūpānāṃ pradapṛṣṭha mukhodbhavam ||
tantoṣu rasajaṃ hvāptivānyāmā rudhirastathā | strīpuṃnapuṃsakādanayajātiścāntaṃ vikalpitam ||
brahmaṃ daivikamānuṣyaṃ paiśācaṃ kalpayet tataḥ | antyarantaravarṇāni kaṃsadhvanisamanvitam ||
evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ devikaṃ kalaśānvitam | śvetaṃ raktaṃ tathā miśraṃ bhinnaṃ kaṃsadhvaniryutam ||
pūrvaśabdasamāyuktaṃ brāhmikaṃ kalaśāni ca | kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ tathā śvetaṃ dhūmravarṇasamanvitam ||
diśe diśe saptabhinnāni mānuṣaṃ kalaśāni cā | sarvavarṇasamāyuktaṃ mekavarṇena bhūṣitam ||
mṛktikāśabdasaṃyuktaṃ paiśācaṃ kalaśā smṛtā | strīṇāṃ bukodaraścaivā puliṅgāvāk bhavaṃ bṛhat ||
mūlāgra ca samaṃ caiva varṇapuṃsaghaṭāni cā | bhārgavaṃ saṃmukhamityāhu romāntaṃ mukhamucyate ||
svasvarūpakamityāhu sthaṇḍilaṃ pādameva ca | bhūtasthā pṛṣṭhamevokta puṣpamālā ca vā bāhukau ||
(146ā) dantaścinnañca puṣpāṇi jelena prāṇameva ca | hastiratnaṃ sirātantu māṃ va mṛṇmayameva cā ||
śivārthaṃ kalaśaṃ proktaṃ śaktyarthaṃ kalaśaṃ śṛṇu | randhrāṅgulapravistāraṃ vardhanī ca virasya tu ||
abdhyaṃgulaṃ tadutsethaṃ vakṣamanyaṃgulaṃ bhavet | viśvanyaṅgulamoṣṭhaṃ tu pārśve tu nāsikāyutam ||
sārdhaṃgulapramāṇena utpalākṛtivat kuruḥ | ardhāṅgulatrayaṃ grīvamaṅgulaṃ co nirgamam ||
vardhanīṃ lakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ kalaśānāṃ śṛṇuṣvathā | rudrāṅgulaṃ tu vistāram utsedhaṃ parvatāṅgulam ||
sāddhāṅgulagalotsedhaḥ moṣaṃ tu samameva tu | yatvaṅgulaṃ tu vistāraṃ yavamoṣṭhasya nirgamam ||
kalaṅkarahitaṃ śuddhaṃ kaṃsaśabdadravaṃ viduḥ | vedāgninayanaprasthai saṃpūrṇā saṃyathā kramam ||
śreṣṭhaṃ madhyaṃ kaniṣṭhāsu kalaśāsnapanocitaḥ | sarveṣāṃ kalaśānāṃ tu śivakuṃbhañcaturguṇam ||
śaktikumbhañca kalaśādviguṇasya pramāṇataḥ | śaṅkhairvā śuktikairvāpi gavāṃ śṛṅgāgrakairathā |
śaṅkhaśuktikaśṛṅgāṇāṃ svapramāṇena pūrayet | gulaṃ candanalohāni koṣṭhaṃ kaccolapuṣpakam ||
patraṃ karpūranīvārau dantaṃ māṃsīmurannṛṇām | śamī dūrvā ca śuklārkabilvacambakaśaṅkhinī ||
(146B) apāmārgaṃ tato viṣṇukrānti dhūrdhūrasaṃjñakam | nandyāvartāsitābjaṃ cā śatvāriṃśannavādhikam ||
vyūhatrameṇa mabhyarcyā devānāṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukhaḥ | vidyeśān prathama yaṣṭvān arcayet svasvanāmabhiḥ ||
indrādīśānaparyantaṃ madhyakumbhe yajet sudhi | śeṣeṣu kalaśāścaivā haṃsamantreṇa marcayet ||
idamanyat pravakṣyāmi tava snehāt prakāśitam | prāksūtraṃ yugmasūtraṃ syāt udaksūtraṃ tathaiva cā ||
paritassaptasūtrāṇa kārayettu viśeṣataḥ | prathamāvaraṇe veda dvitīye cāṣṭakaṃ nyaset ||
tṛtīye staraṇe bhānuścaturviṃśat caturthake | dravyadevān purā proktā kārayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ ||
[iti vātulākhye mahātantre 'ṣṭācatvārisnapanaṃ paṭalaḥ] ||
caturuttaraṣaṣṭisnapanavidhiḥ ||
caturuttaraṣaṣṭiṃ syāt snapanaṃ vakṣyate'dhunā | prāksūtra dvādaśāñcaivā udaksūtraṃ tathaiva cā ||
madhye navapadaṃ grāhyā paritaḥ ṣoḍaśaṃ tyajet | mahādik tripadaṃ daḥ parirekāvṛtaṃ caret ||
prathamāvaraṇe cāṣṭau dvitīye viṃśatistathā | ṣṭtriṃśaśca tṛtīye tu catuṣṣaṣṭhi prakīrtitā ||
raktā ca raktamandāraṃ palāśaṃ pāṭalī tathā | raktapatmaṃ ca bṛhati aśokaṃ piṇḍikaṃ tathā ||
(147ā) prathamāvaraṇe nyasya dvitīyāvaraṇe tataḥ | cambakaṃ karṇikāraṃ ca tathā raśvathameva ca ||
karaṇḍaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ cā viṣṇukrāntiṃ samāharet | dvitīyāvaraṇe nyasya tṛtīye tu nigadyate ||
tulasī bilvavadarī macī bhraṅgamadhuddhūram | śamiṃ ca karavīraṃ cā sindhūvāraṃ ca gaṇḍīlī ||
aśmāntaścāpamārgaścā ārjunaṃ ḍaḍimi tathā | kapitthaṃ vāraṇe nīlā varṇī tu śaṅkhinī tathā ||
girikarṇidvayaṃ caivā sahadevī tapasvinī | haridāramayūraṃ cā śrīkṛṣṇatulasī tathā ||
nandyāvartaṃ śriyāvartaṃ śriyāvartaṃ mallikā mādhavī tathā | jambū cūta śamī cāthā vai devyamaruvaṃ tathā ||
damanā ca krameṇaiva patrāṇyetāni nikṣipet | śivaṃ gauristayoryadvā kumbhayostadanukramāt ||
prathamāvaraṇe caiva aṣṭavidyeśvarā nyaset | vaikartanavivasvāntaṃ bhayaṃ sarvamataḥ param ||
mārtāṇḍaṃ bhaskaraṃ caivā raviṃ rudraṃ tathaiva cā | pā(*?)śamugranāmānāṃ lokabhāsaṃ tathaiva cā ||
lokasākṣimanantaṃ cā mahāntaṃ bhīmameva cā | trivikramaṃ tathā''dityaṃ sūryamaṃśumatā sahā ||
divākaraṃ tathaiśānāṃ dvitīyāvaraṇe nyaset | varadaṃ vīrabhadraṃ cā vimalaṃ viśvagocaram ||
vedaniṣṭaṃ purānandaṃ parameśaṃ mahādyatim | (147B) mahoraska mahāgamya janmassāvasanaṃ śuci ||
trilocanaṃ manopamyaṃ ṭaṅgapāṇimahāgatam | śūlapāṇiṃ mahotsāhaṃ mahābhairavarūpiṇam ||
daṃṣṭriṇaṃ ca durādharṣaṃ hārabhūtiṃ ca vajriṇam | daṇḍinaṃ śipiviṣṭaṃ ca vyāghracarmadharaṃ haram ||
analasya malakṣaṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam | dussahaṃ ca triyaṃ rūpaṃ devādimanujaṃ tathā ||
gaṇeśaṃ ca sureśaṃ ca vyālayajñopavītanam | durgañca surasenābhyaṃ tritiyāvaraṇe yejet ||
[iti vātulākhye mahātantre catuṣaṣṭhisnapanaṃ paṭalaḥ] ||
saptaviṃśati snapanam ||
dvisaptati kalaśāḥ
dvisaptatiśca kalaśān vakṣyate snapanaṃ guhā | trihastaṃ pañcahastaṃ vā ṣaṭ saptāṣṭa navastathā ||
yekādaśakaraṃ vātha triyodaśakaraṃ tu vā | pañcādaśakaraṃ vātha maṇḍapaṃ kārayet tataḥ ||
prāgupta navabhedena ṛṣiścandādidevatāḥ | agastyena samāyuktaṃ jagatīścandasaṃyutam ||
ādityena samāyuktam uttamatrayamucyate | vasiṣṭhena samāyuktaśaṅkarīśca śchanda ucyate ||
vighneśena samāyukta madhyamatrayamucyate | vyāsenaiva samāyuktamanuṣṭup chandasaṃyutam ||
skandenaiva samāyuktaṃ kanyasatrayamucyate | ṛṣiśchandaśca devāścā tava snehā prakāśitam ||
(148ā) prāk sūtraṃ manusūtraṃ syāt udaksūtraṃ tathaiva ca | madhye navapadaṃ grāhya śivakumbhaṃ nyasedbudhaḥ ||
ṣoḍaśasvabāhye tu aṣṭadvārāṇi kalpayet | indrādīna caturdikṣu grahasaṃkhyā prakīrtitāḥ ||
koṇeṣu pañcakalaśān sthāpayettu vidhānataḥ | śeṣāni ca padā sarve tyajet gomayavāriṇā ||
dvisaptakalaśaṃ prokṣa dravyāndevīn śṛṇuṣvathā | tatkolaṃ bhasmaniryāsaṃ hariveraṃ ca mañcari ||
nālikeraṃ ca vilvaṃ ca jambūkaccolapāṭali | punnāgaṃ śaṅkhapuṣpaṃ ca lakṣmī vyāghranakhī tathā ||
siṃhī dhūddhūrasaṃjñañca ṣoḍaśaṃ cāvinirdiśet | prathamāvaraṇe nyasya caturdikṣurathocyate ||
dūrvāsarṣapamabhrau ca nāraṅgapanasau matau | kadalīśatapatraṃ ca dhātakiśvetalobhṛvam ||
gṛhyasaṃkhyāni dravyāṇi pūrvāyāṃ diśi nikṣipet | yukṣusāraṃ ca lābjā ca cambakaṃ gandhatailakam ||
nīvāraṃ kuṅkumaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ lāsī ca mukhasaktukau | navānyetāni dravyāṇi yamāyāṃ diśi vinyaset ||
mudgamāṣaṃ ca cimbaṃ ca yavaveṇu priyaṅguṣu | sarṣapaṃ śālinācaiva aḍakaṃ ca naveṣu cā ||
vāruṇyāṃ diśi nikṣipya udīcyāṃ diśi cocyate | elālavaṅgakaccolaṃ turdi mambuyavaṃ tathā ||
kuṣṭhaṃ ca kuṅkumaṃ caiva (---)gha mārgamuraṅgulam | (148B) pañcasaṃkhyāni dravyāṇi yāvadvāndivinyaset ||
sihmī ca śaṅkhapuṣpaṃ ca apāmārge dravallikā | kṣudraparṇī tapasvī ca aiśāṃ diśi vinyaset ||
vyāṇyetāni sarvāṇi pūrvādikramato nyaset | dvibhujaṃ niṣkaparyantaṃ pādyādyantaṃ prakīrtitam ||
eka dvi tri catuḥ prasthaṃ pañcagavyādi nāmakam | madhvādīnāṃ tathā proktaṃ pādamardhamathāpi vā ||
ājyaṃ taila pramāṇaṃ tu tathaiva parikīrtitam | karpūrakuṅkumādīnāṃ mānamiṣṭaṃ prakīrtitam ||
ratnāni svapramāṇāni praśastāri ṣaḍānana | daśamāṇādivṛddhyā tu niṣkāntaṃ lohamānakam ||
lohānāṃ caiva mānaṃ syāt tathāpāṣāṇamānakam | niṣkapādādivṛddhyā tu phalāntaṃ bījamānakam ||
etaṃ taṇḍulamānaṃ syāt nilamānaṃ tathaiva ca | phalāni vā yathā mānaṃ śeṣamadbhi prapūjayet ||
ghṛtaṃvat tailamānaṃ syāt sarvaṃ vā pātramānavat | tasyardhaṃ tu tadardhaṃ vā puṣpahastamidaṃ bhavet ||
oṣadhīṃ tatsamamaṃ proktaṃ manyadapyevamiṣyate | prāmānahīne dāridramadhitokaranāśakam ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena mānaṃ māne samācaret | vajraṃ samastaratnānāṃ lohānāmayasaṃ matam ||
yavammakhilabījānā dhātūṇāṃ haritālakam | (149ā) oṣadhīnāmabhāve tu sahade dadhatīṃ śrīphalāmbujām ||
hemābhāṃ sakhaṭepābhyāṃ plāvyamānāṃ mahāśriyam |
oṃ śrīṃ mahālakṣmyai namaḥ ||
aiśānyām diśi saptagurūnabhyarcya sadāśivamanantaṃ ca śrīkaṇṭhaṃ punarambikām | gṛhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca dhātāraṃ gurūn sapta smaran yajet |
kundendu nirmalodeva + mantraṃ pañcava brahma(-)hā tanu daśabāhuprasannāsyā pañcavaktrassadāśivaḥ |

mahākālastriṇetrastu kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ caturbhujaḥ | ubhayavaradopeta magraśūlastu tomaraḥ ||
oṃ hāṃ mahākālāya namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ devayonyai namaḥ |
caturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca bhṛṅgīśaṃ piṅgalaprabham | dakṣiṇe'bhayaṭaṅkaṃ tu vāme varadaśūladhṛk ||
oṃ hāṃ bhṛṅgiṇe namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ kundyai namaḥ |
gajānanaṃ triṇetraṃ ca kuṅkumābhaṃ caturbhujam | pāśadantau tu saumye tu vāmetvaṅkuśalaḍḍukam ||
(156ā) nāgayajñopavītaṃ tu lamboṣṭhaṃ ca gaṇādhipam |
oṃ hāṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ kālyai namaḥ |
(--------------------) raktassarve purā mṛtāḥ | sitakṛṣṇamayī cākṣī dvau śṛṅgau raktavarṇakau ||
karṇau ca raktavarṇābhau bālāpītena śobhitā | khaṇḍā mālā suvarṇābhā sthitaṃ vāsayitaṃ tu vā ||
oṃ hāṃ vṛṣabhāya namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ mantriṇyai namaḥ |
raktavastromahāseno dvinetrāśca caturbhujā | savyetvabhayavajraṃ tu vāme ca varadāṅkuśau ||
oṃ hāṃ skandāya namaḥ | oṃ hāṃ mālinyai namaḥ |
(----------------------------------------------------) cāriṇi | prāṇāpāna tathāvyānau dānaṃ ca samānakam ||
satvaṃ rajastamaścaivā rakṣennārāyaṇīṃ tathā | āyurme rakṣa vārāhi dharmaṃ rakṣettu yoginī ||
yaśaḥ kīrtiñca lakṣmīṃ ca tadhā rakṣatu vaiṣṇavī | gotramindrāṇi me rakṣe tu parame rakṣa tu caṇḍike ||
putrān rakṣa mahālakṣmī bhāryaṃ rakṣa tu vaiṣṇavī | mārge kṣetrakarī rakṣedvijayā sarvadā śubhā ||
rakṣāhīnaṃ tu yatsthānaṃ varjitaṃ kavacena tu | tatsarvaṃ rakṣa me devī jayantī pāpanāśinī ||
brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ devyā dhṛtvāna kavacaṃ naraḥ | padameka na gacchedayadicchedayadicchesiddhimāniyāt ||
kavacenāvṛto nityaṃ yatra yatrābhigacchati | tatra tatrārthalābhaśca vijayaṃ sarvakālikam ||
yaṃ yaṃ cintayate kāmyaṃ tantamāpnoti līlayā | paramaiśvaryamatulaṃ prāpyate bhūtale pumān ||
nirbhayo jāyate martyaḥ saṅgrāmeṣvaparājitaḥ | jīvedvarupaśataṃ puṇyamapamṛtyuvināśanam ||
naśyanti vyādhayassarve lūtādi sphoṭakādayaḥ | sthāvarañjaṅgamaṃ caiva kṛtrimaṃ caiva yadviṣam ||
kumbhīrāṇi sarvāṇi mantrayantrāṇi bhūtale | bhūcaraḥ khecaraścaivā kulajāścepadeśikaḥ ||
(B) sahaja bhruvermadhye yaśasvinī | netrayościtrakhaṇḍaṃ ca tāluke śaṅkhinī ||
śaṅhinī cakṣuṣormadhye śrotrayorvindhyavāsī | kāmākṣī cibukaṃ rakṣet vācāṃ vai sarva maṅgalā ||
grīvāyāṃ bhadrakālī cā pṛṣṭhaṃ me ca dhanurdharā | nīlagrīvā bahiḥ kaṇṭhe nāsikāṃ nalakūbarā ||
khaḍgadhāriṇyubhau sarve bāhū me vaṃ tridhāriṇī | hastau tu daṇḍinī rakṣet guhyaṃ guhyeṣvarī tathā ||
durgā ca me gudaṃ rakṣet kaṭyāṃ bhaga tī tathā | bhaktānāṃ nāyakī medhā rūme meṣu(ṣa)vāhinī ||
jānvormahābalā proktā jaṅghayośca vināyakaḥ | gulphayornārasiṃhī cā padapṛṣṭhe dvi(ddhi)taunasi ||
pādāṅgulīstu śrīrakṣe pādakṛsthalavāsinī | daṃṣṭrākarāla ca nakhān romāṇḍā muktakeśinī ||
romāṇi vāṇi kauberī tvacaṃ vāgīśvarī tathā | raktaṃ majjāṃ ca māṃsāni asthi medaṃsi pārvatī ||
antrāṇi kālarātrī ca meḍhraṃ ca makuleśvarī | padmāvatī padmakeśī kumbhe cūḍāmaṇistathā ||
jvālāmukhī tathā jvālāmabhedāṃ sarvasandhiṣu | śuklāṃ brahmāṇi me rakṣe cchāyā cchatreśvarī tathā ||

bhairavāṣṭakam (?)
nāśanaṃ vāpa(pā-; yāva)dvāstubaliṃ pūrve dāpayet ca bali bhramam |
(paścimadvāraliṅgaṃ ca balibāruṇya mācaret ||
ṛaityāntabaliṃ bhrāmya dāpayet vidhipūrvakam | dakṣiṇadvāradevasya bali vinyasya deśikaḥ ||
dakṣiṇādyagniparyanta dvārāṇāṃ tu baliṃ dadet | uttaradvāraliṅgaṃ ca saumyena balimācaret ||)
ālayāt pūrvato grāmamindrādīśānamācaret | ālayāt paścimat grāmaṃ vāruṇyādyādi nairite ||
dakṣiṇe cālayaṃ caivā uttare grāmameva cā | somādivāyuparyantaṃ dāpayet vidhipūrvakam ||
uttare ālayaṃ caiva dakṣiṇe grāmameva ca | dakṣiṇādyagniparyantaṃ saṃhārakramato baliḥ ||
[iti kāraṇe caturdvārabalividhi samāptaḥ] ||
bhairavāṣṭakam ||
pareta bhūtavetāla karatālasamanvitam | kapardinaṃ mahānityaṃ kalaye kālabhairavam || 1 ||
kapālamālikaṃ krāntaṃ jagatpāvakalocanam | kapālakaramatyurgaṃ kalaye kālabhairavam || 2 ||
darvīkaradraṇaproktaṃ kiṅkiṇīmekhalānvitam | kuṇḍalambijaḍādhāraṃ kalaye kālabhairavam || 3 ||
(106> maṇipādakapādābjaṃ mahāśūlakarāmbujam | kathākarṇukasaṅkrāntaṃ kalaye kālabhairavam || 4 ||
digambarajapāvarṇaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam | cārucandrakalācūṭaṃ kalaye kālabhairavam || 5 ||
bhānu bhānuprabhākāraṃ nīlakomalakuntalam | sphuraddaṇḍakapālāḍhyaṃ kalaye kālabhairavam || 6 ||
surārivanadāvāgniṃ surakairavaśītalam | śivakeśavayoraikyaṃ kalaye kālabhairavam || 7 ||
yasya jñāya (-syājñayā)jagatsarvaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamānukam | vartate nirbhayā nityaṃ kalaye kālabhairavam || 8 ||
yasidaṃ kālanādhasya paṭhet bhaktyāṣṭakaṃ sadā | sa eva labhate kāśīṃ prayāgāṃ ca gayāṃ tathā ||
tadastu kāśigamana viśvanādhastu darśanam | tata svadeśagamanaṃ punarbāndhavadarśanam ||
apāramiṣṭamannaṃ ca kālanādhaḥ prayacchati |
karakalitakapālaḥ kuṇḍalī daṇḍapāṇiḥ staruṇamitimiranīlo vyālayajñopavīti | kratusamayaparīya vighnavicchedahe(bhe)nnā jayatu gharakanādhaḥ siddhitaḥ sādhakānām ||
ānīlakomalakuntalamalaktakaraktavarṇam aṅgīkṛto smitamanogra mukhāravindam | (ā) kalyāṇadaṇḍakamanīya jaṭākalāpaṃ vande mahāvaṭukanāthamabhīṣṭasiddhim ||
[iti bhairavastotraṃ sampūrṇam] ||
[atha nirmālya vidhiḥ] ||
śubhamastu ||
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi nirmālyāsya vidhi śṛṇu | caṇḍadravyaṃ ca nirmālyaṃ athātasaṣaṭvidhaṃ ceti kīrtitam ||
gṛmādīśasavedaṃ so devadravyamivādikam | vastramābharaṇaṃ caiva gandhatailaṃ ca puṣpakam ||
candanaṃ caiva śuddhānnaṃ nirmālyaṃ ca prakīrtitaḥ | śiṣṭaliṅgārcanaṃ liṅgaṃ viśeṣamadhunocyate ||
tanniveditanirmālyaṃ śaivānāṃ bhojanādhikam | śubhadaṃ cittasaṃhāraṃ māyuṣyaṃ bālavardhanam ||
ātmārthaṃ caiva liṅgaṃ ca nirmālyaṃ caiva kathyate | liṅgaṃ cet mānuṣaṃ caivā nirmālyaṃ tu na saṃśayaḥ ||
nirmālyaṃ nirmalaṃ śuddhaṃ nirmalātmāna bhojanam | malabandhaśarīreṣu nirmālyaṃ tu na bhuñjyate ||
tasmāt śivasya naivedyaṃ śuddhadravyamiti smṛtam | śivena dīkṣitaṃ caivā śivabrāhmaṇamucyate ||
śivaśuddhasvarūpaṃ ca hi vāṅmanādyatagocaram | tasmāt śivadvijo vipraḥ śuddhabrāhmaṇamucyate ||
śivanirmālyaṃ yogyaṃ tu anyeṣāṃ tu na yogyatam | (105B) anyeṣāṃ saṅgrahe nyastvā jātikṛtya samācaret ||
sparśane pāṇipādaṃ tu prakṣālyācamya vāriṇā | sparśana prakṣālanaṃ hastaṃ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuru ||
pramādāt bhojanaṃ kṛtvā narakaṃ candradivākarau | jale pāśupatervāpi bhūmau vā pahimeva cā ||
vināyakasya naivedyaṃ vibhrāṇāṃ tu vibhojanam | umādevīṃ ca naivedyaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhojayet tataḥ ||
subrahmaṇyasya naivedyaṃ bhojanaṃ ca jayārdhanam | bhāskarasya tu naivedyaṃ hatyāvyādhikrayaṃ bhavet ||
parivārādinaivedyaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhojayet tataḥ |
[iti nirmālyavidhiḥ samāptaḥ] ||

devīkavacam ||
yat guhyaṃ paramaṃ loke sarvarakṣākaraṃ nṛṇām | yanna kasyacidākhyevā ta me brūhi pitā ha ||
brahmauvācā
hasti guhyatamaṃ vipra sarvabhūtopakārakam | devyāstu kavacaṃ puṇyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmate ||
idaṃ bhaktāya deyaṃ syāt nabhaktāya kadācana | nāstikāya ca duṣṭāya kṛpaṇāya mahāmune ||
kavacasya ṛṣi brahmā chando nuṣṭu prakīrtitaḥ | devatā śrīṃ mahālakṣmī sarvakāmyārthasiddhidā ||
agninā dahyamānāśca śatrumadhyagatā raṇe | viṣṭame durgame vāpi bhayartā śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||
na teṣāṃ jāyate kiñcidaśubhaṃ raṇasaṅkaṭe | nāpādaṃ teṣu paśyāmi śokaduḥkhabhayaṅkarīm ||
yaistu bhaktyā stutāṃ nityaṃ teṣāṃ vṛddhi prajāyate | pretasaṃstho hi cāmuṇḍī vārāhī mahiṣāsanā ||
māheśvarī vṛṣārūḍhā kaumārī śikhivāhanā | aindrī gajāsanārūḍhā (devi krotha) vaiṣṇavī garuḍāsanā ||
brahmā haṃsasamārūḍhā sarvābharaṇa bhūṣitā | nānābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā nānāratnaiśca bhūṣitā ||
(120B) dṛśyante radhamārūḍhā devi krotha samāhitaḥ | śaṅkhaṃ cakragadāṃ śaktiṃ śūlaṃ ca musalāyudham ||
kheṭakaṃ tomaraṃ caiva paraśuṃ pāśameva cā | daityānāṃ dehanāśāyā bhaktānāmabhayāya ca ||
dhārayitvā yudhānītvā devanāñca hitāya vai | indranīlaṃ mahānīla paramarāgaiśca śobhite ||
mauktikaiśca śubhairdivyairhāranūpurakuṇḍalaiḥ |
oṃ
namostute mahārūpe mahāghora parākrame | mahābale mahāvīrye mahābhayavīnāśini ||
trāha māṃ devi duṣṭrekṣye śatrūṇāṃ bhavavardhani | prācyāṃ rakṣatu māhendri māgneyyāmagnidevatā ||
dakṣiṇe rakṣavārāhī nairṛtyāṃ khaṭgadhāriṇi | pradīcyāṃ vāruṇī rakṣedvāyavyāṃ mṛgadhāriṇi ||
udīcyāṃ rakṣa kauberī yīśānyāṃ śūladhāriṇī |
ūrdhvaṃ brahmāṇi me rakṣe dathastādvaiṣṇavī tathā | evaṃ daśa diśo rakṣet cāmuṇḍā śavavāhini ||
jayā me cāgrataḥ pātu vijayā pātu pṛṣṭhataḥ | ajitā vāmapārśve tu dakṣiṇe cāparājitā |
śikhāmudyotarī rakṣedumā mūrdhni vyavasthitā | mālādhārī lalāṭe tu
(etadantamidaṃ patram ||)
(124ā) (------------------------------------------) māpnuyāt | sadāyuṣyaṃ bhavetsatyaṃ skanda bhaktiśca jāyate |
śikhāṃ rakṣet kumāraṃ ca kārtikeya śirastathā | lalāṭaṃ pārvatīsūnuṃ viśākho bhrūyugaṃ tathā ||
netre ca krauñcabhedī cā nāsikāṃ śikhivāhanaḥ | śaktiyuktastathā karṇau karṇamūle ṣaḍānanaḥ ||
oṣṭhadvayaṃ ca senāni rasanāṃ tārakāpahā | dantaṃ guha sadāpātu gāṅgeyaścibukaṃ tathā ||
kaṇṭhaṃ bhavodbhavaḥ pātu vācaṃ vai śambhunandanaḥ | pārvatīnandano grīvaṃ bahiḥ kaṇṭhaṃ tathāgnibhūḥ ||
nāsikāṃ bāhuleyastu skandha ṣāṇmāturastathā | viśākho bāhuyugmaṃ tu hastau pātu vaṇik tathā ||
vināyakānujaḥ pātu cāṅgulī nakhaśālikhaḥ | subrahmaṇyassadā kakṣau kukṣiṃ rakṣet ssurārihā ||
vaigaṇḍaṃ ca tathā jñeyāstanau rakṣejjagadvibhuḥ | hṛdayaṃ yuddhaśūrastu manaḥ kāruṇyavārudhiḥ ||
udaraṃ me manaścāri ghaṭiṃ bhaktekavatsalaḥ | (124B) nābhidvaparamācaryo yoniṃ vā vāñcitaḥ pradaḥ ||
guhyaṃ śaśidharaḥ pātu śipikṣepaṃ śarīphadhṛk | ūrupāyādurāsūnurjānunī vahnikāpriyāḥ ||
jaṅghe pātu dhanādhyakṣo pādagulphau mahābalaḥ | pādau rakṣatu pāpaghnaṃ sarvāṅgaṃ kukkuṭadhvajaḥ ||
vapā majjāstaraktatvak medhośśuddhāssadattavat | devacūḍāmaṇiḥ pātu makuṭaṃ patmagocaram ||
mahāparākramaḥ pātu kapardī śambhunandanaḥ | śivānando nidhisthānaṃ buddhyādīmunisevitam ||
prāṇādipāyūn sarvajñaḥ ṣaḍvaktrastu sadāvatu | lakṣmīkīrtiguṇān gotraṃ bhāryān putrān vibhustathā ||
tathājñāmalayaḥ pātu sarvadevābhayapradā | sthalaṃ yatrakṣaṇaṃ śūnyaṃ kavacena vivarjitam ||
tatsarvaṃ rakṣatuḥ pāyo nityaṃ yauvanagocaram | kāmyārthasya sadā siddhiḥ kavacasmaraṇāt bhavet ||
saṅgrame jayalābhaśca sarveṣāṃ jayakāraṇam | bhūtapretapiśācāti śūnyaduṣkṛtanāśanam ||

vajraviriñca jaleśa purogai(-) rarcitapādasaroruhayugmam | viśvajanīnamutaikamanekaṃ skandakumāra(-) mumāsutamīḍe || 1 ||

(ā) raktavarṇajaṭāyuktaṃ tatra brahma guruṃ smaret | mahāṃ brahmagurubhyo namaḥ ||
vināyakavrataṃ vakṣye śrūyatāṃ ravisattama | jagat vighnavināśārthaṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradam ||
sarvopadravināśārthaṃ pūjayitvā gaṇeśvaram | taddinasyādirātrau tu deveśaṃ pūjayet tataḥ ||
pañcagavyāmṛtenaivā pūjayet vighnanāyakam | kautukaṃ bandhayeddhīmān navavastreṇa veṣṭayet ||
apūrvaṃ pāyasādannamupadaṃśasamanvitam | tāmbūlaṃ mukhavāsaṃ ca dāpayet tu gaṇeśvaram ||
dhūpadīpādikaṃ datvā stotraṃ kuru yatepsitam | nṛttagānaiśca santoṣya rātriśeṣaṃ vyapohya ca ||
tataḥ prabhātasamaye nityānuṣṭhānamācaret | āmodadhūpadīpaiśca raṅgecāstraveṣṭayet ||
vivṛktāsṛtyamavidhai dravyai vighneśvarānvitam | vrataṃ vijñāpya deveśaṃ pañcagavyāmṛtena cā ||
anyaiśca snapanaṃ dravyai snapayet tu gaṇeśvaram | alaṅkṛtya viśeṣeṇa gandhapuṣpasragādibhiḥ ||
bhakṣyāpūpādikaṃ dadyāt dhūpadīpādisevitam | mūlamantraissamabhyarcyā abhīṣṭaṃ prārthayet sudhim ||
